title: "CBS-MIT Election Night"
author: "[MIT]"
format:
  dashboard:
    theme:
      - default
      - custom.scss
    embed-resources: true
    logo: assets/cbs_white.svg
    code-copy: false
    include-in-header:
      text: |
        <meta http-equiv="X-UA-Compatible" content="IE=edge">
        <link rel="shortcut icon mask-icon" type="image/svg+xml" href="https://www.cbsnews.com/fly/bundles/cbsnewscore/icons/icon.svg" color="#101010">
---

```{r r-setup}
#| include: false
# State x Contest selections live in DASHBOARD_CONTESTS (scripts/util/globals.R).
# Everything below is drawn client-side (OJS) from dashboard_data.
# For testing outside the pipeline, point CBS_DASH_RDS at a saved build_dashboard_data() rds.
dd = if (nzchar(Sys.getenv("CBS_DASH_RDS"))) readRDS(Sys.getenv("CBS_DASH_RDS")) else targets::tar_read(dashboard_data)

to_ms = \(x) as.numeric(x) * 1000

ojs_define(
  meta = transform(dd$meta, time = to_ms(time), cbs_time = if (is.null(dd$meta$cbs_time)) NA_real_ else to_ms(dd$meta$cbs_time)),
  ts = transform(dd$ts, time = to_ms(time)),
  # Results "All places": scraped summaries + CBS counts for unscraped counties (all_places_ts() in functions.R)
  ts_all = if (is.null(dd$ts_all) || !nrow(dd$ts_all)) data.frame(key = character(), time = numeric(), method = character()) else transform(dd$ts_all, time = to_ms(time)),
  prec = dd$prec,
  l2 = if (is.null(dd$l2)) data.frame(key = character(), geo = character(), mode = character()) else dd$l2,
  models = if (is.null(dd$models)) data.frame(key = character(), model = character(), time = numeric()) else transform(dd$models, time = to_ms(time)),
  model_status = if (is.null(dd$model_status)) data.frame(key = character(), model = character()) else transform(dd$model_status, time = to_ms(time)),
  model_turnout = if (is.null(dd$model_turnout) || !nrow(dd$model_turnout)) data.frame(key = character(), model = character(), geo = character(), time = numeric()) else transform(dd$model_turnout, time = to_ms(time)),
  mres = if (is.null(dd$mres)) data.frame(key = character(), unit_id = character()) else dd$mres,
  mprec = if (is.null(dd$mprec)) data.frame(key = character(), model = character(), unit_id = character()) else dd$mprec,
  mprec_runs = if (is.null(dd$mprec_runs)) data.frame(key = character(), model = character(), time = numeric()) else transform(dd$mprec_runs, time = to_ms(time)),
  # Models page Shift Map basemap: L2 shares per VoteHub unit, by state (build_dashboard_data() in functions.R)
  mdemo = if (is.null(dd$mdemo) || !nrow(dd$mdemo)) data.frame(state = character(), unit_id = character()) else dd$mdemo,
  mcty = if (is.null(dd$mcty)) data.frame(key = character(), county_fips = character()) else dd$mcty,
  # CBS expected vote over time, total and by method (read_cbs_expected() in functions.R)
  cbs_exp = if (is.null(dd$cbs_exp) || !nrow(dd$cbs_exp)) data.frame(key = character(), geo = character(), method = character(), time = numeric(), expected = numeric()) else transform(dd$cbs_exp, time = to_ms(time)),
  geo_url = if (is.null(dd$geo_url)) "data/dashboard/geo" else dd$geo_url,
  dash_title = dd$title,
  # test data (pages.yml sets CBS_DASH_SOURCE from dashboard_mode.txt): a TEST DATA badge in the header
  dash_test = Sys.getenv("CBS_DASH_SOURCE") == "test" || grepl("dashtest", Sys.getenv("CBS_DASH_RDS")),
  # MEDSL header logo on the right (format: logo takes only one, the CBS one on the left), inlined for embed-resources
  medsl_header_logo = paste0("data:image/png;base64,", base64enc::base64encode("assets/MEDSL_horizontal_RGB_KO.png")),
  # chart exports: ggmedsl's Styrene B and lab logo (assets/), VoteHub logo for the precinct maps' basemap credit
  medsl_font = paste0("data:font/ttf;base64,", base64enc::base64encode("assets/StyreneB_Regular.ttf")),
  medsl_logo = paste0("data:image/png;base64,", base64enc::base64encode("assets/medsl_horizontal.png")),
  votehub_logo = paste0("data:image/svg+xml;base64,", base64enc::base64encode("assets/votehub-logo-simple.svg")),
  top_model = if (is.null(dd$top_model)) "" else dd$top_model,
  # county urbanicity (USDA RUCC 2023) for the Demographics page swing plots, from the model reference table
  # (scripts/model/prep/make_model_reference.R); states it doesn't cover get no Urbanicity blocks
  rurality = subset(read.csv("scripts/model/lookups/model_counties.csv", colClasses = "character"),
                    rurality != "", c(state, county_cbs, rucc, rurality)),
  # Demographics page race EI (dashboard_ei() in scripts/functions.R)
  ei = if (is.null(dd$ei)) data.frame(key = character(), year = character(), group = character()) else dd$ei,
  truth = if (is.null(dd$truth)) data.frame(key = character(), dem = numeric(), rep = numeric(), total = numeric()) else dd$truth,
  # Redistricting page (build_redist_data() in scripts/redistricting_targets.R)
  rd_dist = if (is.null(dd$redist)) data.frame(state = character(), src = character(), plan = character(), cd = character(), dem = numeric(), rep = numeric(), cov = numeric()) else dd$redist$dist,
  rd_src = if (is.null(dd$redist)) data.frame(state = character(), src = character(), time = numeric()) else transform(dd$redist$src, time = to_ms(time)),
  rd_desc = if (is.null(dd$redist$desc)) data.frame(cd = character(), desc = character()) else dd$redist$desc,
  rd_unit = if (is.null(dd$redist$unit)) data.frame(state = character(), src = character(), unit_id = character(), dem = numeric(), rep = numeric()) else dd$redist$unit,
  rd_cty = if (is.null(dd$redist$cty)) data.frame(state = character(), src = character(), county_fips = character(), dem = numeric(), rep = numeric()) else dd$redist$cty
)
```

# Results

## Overview {height="104px"}

```{ojs setup}
//| output: false

M = transpose(meta).map(d => ({ ...d, cbs_time: Number.isFinite(d.cbs_time) ? new Date(d.cbs_time) : null }))
TS = transpose(ts).map(d => ({ ...d, time: new Date(d.time) }))
TSALL = transpose(ts_all).map(d => ({ ...d, time: new Date(d.time) }))
P = transpose(prec)
L2 = transpose(l2)
MP = transpose(models).map(d => ({ ...d, time: new Date(d.time) }))
MS = transpose(model_status)
// race turnout intervals by key|model|geo|time (CONTRACT.md section 15.4)
MT = new Map(transpose(model_turnout).map(d => [`${d.key}|${d.model}|${d.geo}|${d.time}`, d]))
// Models page maps: counted votes and each model's projected remaining vote per VoteHub unit
MRES = transpose(mres)
MPREC = transpose(mprec)
MDEMO = transpose(mdemo)
MPRECRUN = transpose(mprec_runs).map(d => ({ ...d, time: new Date(d.time) }))
// CBS county results for the counties we don't scrape (read_cbs_counties() in functions.R)
MCTY = transpose(mcty)
// CBS expected vote by key, geo (scraped / all), method (total, eday, adv, mail, ...) and time
CBSX = transpose(cbs_exp).map(d => ({ ...d, time: new Date(d.time) }))

// L2 precinct shares, joined to ENR geos through input_data/crosswalks (see read_l2() in functions.R)
L2_COLS = ["l2_n", "l2_turnout20", "l2_turnout22", "l2_turnout24", "l2_male", "l2_white", "l2_black", "l2_hispanic", "l2_asian"]
// ENR method -> L2 vote-mode columns used for turnout; other methods (prov, all) get no turnout
L2_MODE = { return { Total: "Total", eday: "eday", early: "early", adv: "early", mail: "mail", abs: "mail" } }

DEM = "#005599"
REP = "#ce0008"
INK = "#444444"
// two-party margin map colors, one per MARGIN_BINS bin, fading from each party's color to white at even
// (a function so exports can rebuild it with ggmedsl's party colors)
marginRange = (dem, rep) => {
  const shade = (c, t) => d3.interpolateRgb(c, "#ffffff")(t);
  return [shade(rep, 0), shade(rep, 0.3), shade(rep, 0.55), shade(rep, 0.75), shade(dem, 0.75), shade(dem, 0.55), shade(dem, 0.3), shade(dem, 0)];
}

METHOD_LABELS = { return { eday: "Election Day", early: "Early", mail: "Mail", abs: "Absentee", adv: "Advance", prov: "Provisional", all: "All (unsplit)" } }
METHOD_ORDER = ["eday", "early", "adv", "mail", "abs", "prov", "all"]

// counts above 1 print as whole numbers (model predictions are fractional)
fmt = v => d3.format(",")(Math.abs(v) >= 1 ? Math.round(v) : v)
pct = d3.format(".1%")
fmtTime = t => t == null ? "—" : new Date(t).toLocaleString("en-US", { timeZone: "America/New_York", month: "short", day: "numeric", hour: "numeric", minute: "2-digit" }).replace(",", "")

// URL param keeps the selection shareable: index.html?c=GA-sen
sel = {
  const params = new URLSearchParams(location.search);
  const start = M.some(m => m.key === params.get("c")) ? params.get("c") : M[0].key;
  const s = html`<select class="form-select form-select-sm dash-select" aria-label="State and contest">
    ${M.map(m => html`<option value=${m.key} selected=${m.key === start}>${m.label}</option>`)}
  </select>`;
  s.value = start;
  s.addEventListener("input", () => {
    const p = new URLSearchParams(location.search);
    p.set("c", s.value);
    history.replaceState(null, "", `${location.pathname}?${p}${location.hash}`);
  });
  // charts in hidden tabs render at 0 size; nudge Quarto's card sizing when a tab is shown
  document.addEventListener("shown.bs.tab", () => window.dispatchEvent(new Event("resize")));
  const navbar = document.querySelector("#quarto-dashboard-header .navbar-container");
  if (navbar && !document.querySelector(".navbar-logo-medsl")) navbar.append(html`<img src=${medsl_header_logo} alt="MIT Election Data and Science Lab" class="navbar-logo-medsl">`);
  const title = document.querySelector("#quarto-dashboard-header .navbar-title");
  if (title) {
    title.textContent = dash_title;
    title.after(s);
    if (dash_test && !document.querySelector(".dash-test-badge")) title.after(html`<span class="dash-test-badge" title="Simulated results, not live data">TEST DATA</span>`);
  } else {
    document.body.prepend(s);
  }
  return Generators.input(s);
}

cur = M.find(m => m.key === sel)
pc = P.filter(d => d.key === sel)
tsAll = TS.filter(d => d.key === sel)
// summaries up to the global "As of"
tsc = tsAll.filter(d => +d.time <= asofT)
// "All places" (Results toolbar): the same series with CBS's counts for the unscraped counties added
tsPlacesAll = TSALL.filter(d => d.key === sel)
// states where we don't scrape every county; elsewhere the scraped summaries are already statewide
PARTIAL_STATES = ["MI", "OH", "TX"]
partialState = PARTIAL_STATES.includes(cur.state)
usePlacesAll = partialState && places.all && tsPlacesAll.length > 0

// ---- global "As of" ----
// One control for every page: each page's bottom toolbar has an empty <div class="asof-slot">
// (data-note: what that page can't rewind) and the control moves into the shown page's slot.
// It steps among the contest's summary times, model runs and latest scrape; at the newest time
// it follows new data. A new page needs only that slot in a `## {.toolbar}`.
asofTimes = [...new Set([...tsAll.map(d => +d.time), ...MP.filter(d => d.key === sel).map(d => +d.time), cur.time])]
  .filter(Number.isFinite).sort((a, b) => a - b)
// last pick; no inputs, so it survives contest changes
asofMemo = { return {} }
// "As of" is a datetime-local in Eastern time, whatever the viewer's zone
toET = ms => new Date(ms + etOffset(ms)).toISOString().slice(0, 16)
fromET = s => { const u = Date.parse(`${s}:00Z`); return u - etOffset(u - etOffset(u)); }
// { el }: an object, not the node, so the hidden setup cell never takes the node back from its slot
asofCtl = {
  const el = html`<form class="model-ctl asof-ctl">
    <span class="asof-note" hidden></span>
    <span class="model-ctl-asof">
      <label>As of <input type="datetime-local" name="asof" class="form-control form-control-sm"></label>
      <span class="model-ctl-tz">ET</span>
      <button type="button" name="latest" class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-secondary">Latest</button>
    </span>
  </form>`;
  const { asof, latest } = el.elements;
  const note = el.querySelector(".asof-note");
  const first = asofTimes[0], last = asofTimes.at(-1);
  if (last != null) { asof.min = toET(first); asof.max = toET(last); }
  const setAsof = t => { asof.value = t == null ? "" : toET(t); };
  const place = () => {
    const slot = document.querySelector(".dashboard-page.tab-pane.active .asof-slot") ?? document.querySelector(".asof-slot");
    if (slot && el.parentElement !== slot) slot.append(el);
    // write only on change: this runs from a MutationObserver
    const text = slot?.dataset.note ?? "", hide = !text || !(el.value < last);
    if (note.textContent !== text) note.textContent = text;
    if (note.hidden !== hide) note.hidden = hide;
  };
  const update = () => {
    // minute precision; the end of that minute so anything stamped inside it counts
    let t = asof.value ? fromET(asof.value) + 59999 : last;
    if (t == null || t >= last) t = Infinity;
    if (first != null && t < first) { t = first; setAsof(first); }
    el.value = t;
    asofMemo.asof = t;
    place();
  };
  latest.addEventListener("click", () => { setAsof(last); update(); el.dispatchEvent(new Event("input", { bubbles: true })); });
  el.addEventListener("input", update);
  el.addEventListener("submit", e => e.preventDefault());
  // follow the newest data unless an earlier time was picked
  setAsof(Number.isFinite(asofMemo.asof) && last != null ? Math.min(Math.max(asofMemo.asof, first), last) : last);
  update();
  // slots render after this cell on first load, and the shown page changes
  const obs = new MutationObserver(place);
  obs.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });
  document.addEventListener("shown.bs.tab", place);
  invalidation.then(() => { obs.disconnect(); document.removeEventListener("shown.bs.tab", place); el.remove(); });
  return { el };
}
// ms; Infinity at the latest (follows new data)
asofT = Generators.input(asofCtl.el)
asofLatest = !(asofT < (asofTimes.at(-1) ?? Infinity))

// methods with any votes, in a fixed order; a lone "all" would just duplicate Total
modes = {
  const m = METHOD_ORDER.filter(m => pc.some(d => d.method === m && d.total > 0));
  return m.length === 1 && m[0] === "all" ? [] : m;
}
facets = ["Total", ...modes.map(m => METHOD_LABELS[m])]

// precinct rows collapsed across methods; history either repeats per method row (geo-level file) or is per method
histByMethod = cur.hist_by_method === true
geoTotal = d3.rollups(pc, v => ({
  key: v[0].key, geo: v[0].geo, county: v[0].county, src: v[0].src, method: "Total",
  dem: d3.sum(v, d => d.dem), rep: d3.sum(v, d => d.rep), total: d3.sum(v, d => d.total),
  stage: d3.max(v, d => d.stage),
  hist_dem: histByMethod ? d3.sum(v, d => d.hist_dem) : v[0].hist_dem,
  hist_rep: histByMethod ? d3.sum(v, d => d.hist_rep) : v[0].hist_rep,
  hist_total: histByMethod ? d3.sum(v, d => d.hist_total) : v[0].hist_total,
  pres_dem: v[0].pres_dem, pres_rep: v[0].pres_rep
}), d => d.geo).map(([, r]) => r)

withShares = rows => rows.map(d => ({
  ...d,
  facet: d.method === "Total" ? "Total" : METHOD_LABELS[d.method] ?? d.method,
  dem_share: d.total > 0 ? d.dem / d.total : null,
  rep_share: d.total > 0 ? d.rep / d.total : null,
  margin: d.total > 0 ? (d.dem - d.rep) / d.total : null,
  hist_dem_share: d.hist_total > 0 ? d.hist_dem / d.hist_total : null,
  hist_margin: d.hist_total > 0 ? (d.hist_dem - d.hist_rep) / d.hist_total : null,
  // vs. VoteHub's 2024 president on the same precinct (all modes): two-party, as VoteHub has only D and R
  dem_share2: d.dem + d.rep > 0 ? d.dem / (d.dem + d.rep) : null,
  pres_dem_share: d.pres_dem + d.pres_rep > 0 ? d.pres_dem / (d.pres_dem + d.pres_rep) : null,
  pres_margin: d.pres_dem + d.pres_rep > 0 ? (d.pres_dem - d.pres_rep) / (d.pres_dem + d.pres_rep) : null,
  swing: d.dem + d.rep > 0 && d.pres_dem + d.pres_rep > 0 ? d.dem / (d.dem + d.rep) - d.pres_dem / (d.pres_dem + d.pres_rep) : null
}))

l2c = new Map(L2.filter(d => d.key === sel).map(d => [`${d.geo}|${d.mode}`, d]))
// non-turnout L2 vars are the same in every mode; turnout follows the row's vote mode
withL2 = d => {
  const t = l2c.get(`${d.geo}|Total`);
  if (!t) return d;
  const m = l2c.get(`${d.geo}|${L2_MODE[d.method]}`);
  const o = { ...d };
  for (const k of L2_COLS) o[k] = k.startsWith("l2_turnout") ? (m ? m[k] : null) : t[k];
  // votes counted per L2 registrant, against L2's '22 / '24 turnout of the same registrants (same vote mode)
  // above 200% is a bad L2 match (e.g. a stray 1-voter L2 precinct), not turnout: drop it
  o.turnout = m && t.l2_n > 0 && d.total / t.l2_n <= 2 ? d.total / t.l2_n : null;
  o.turnout_chg22 = o.turnout != null && o.l2_turnout22 != null ? o.turnout - o.l2_turnout22 : null;
  o.turnout_chg24 = o.turnout != null && o.l2_turnout24 != null ? o.turnout - o.l2_turnout24 : null;
  return o;
}

precRows = withShares([...geoTotal, ...pc.filter(d => modes.includes(d.method))]).map(withL2)
reported = precRows.filter(d => d.total > 0)

// time series: Total facet + one facet per method present
// scraped summaries only (the Overview boxes), or with "All places" (the time plots)
tsRowsFor = all => {
  if (all) {
    const r = tsPlacesAll.filter(d => +d.time <= asofT && (d.method === "Total" || modes.includes(d.method)))
      .map(d => ({ time: d.time, facet: d.method === "Total" ? "Total" : METHOD_LABELS[d.method], dem: d.dem, rep: d.rep, total: d.total }));
    return r.sort((a, b) => a.time - b.time);
  }
  const tot = d3.rollups(tsc, v => ({ dem: d3.sum(v, d => d.dem), rep: d3.sum(v, d => d.rep), total: d3.sum(v, d => d.total) }), d => +d.time)
    .map(([t, r]) => ({ time: new Date(t), facet: "Total", ...r }));
  const byMode = tsc.filter(d => modes.includes(d.method)).map(d => ({ time: d.time, facet: METHOD_LABELS[d.method], dem: d.dem, rep: d.rep, total: d.total }));
  return [...tot, ...byMode].sort((a, b) => a.time - b.time);
}
tsRows = tsRowsFor(usePlacesAll)
tsRowsScraped = tsRowsFor(false)
tsLong = tsRows.flatMap(d => [
  { time: d.time, facet: d.facet, series: "Total", votes: d.total, share: null },
  { time: d.time, facet: d.facet, series: cur.dem_name ?? "Dem", party: "dem", votes: d.dem, share: d.total > 0 ? d.dem / d.total : null },
  { time: d.time, facet: d.facet, series: cur.rep_name ?? "Rep", party: "rep", votes: d.rep, share: d.total > 0 ? d.rep / d.total : null }
])
partyColor = { return { type: "categorical", domain: [cur.dem_name ?? "Dem", cur.rep_name ?? "Rep"], range: [DEM, REP], legend: true } }

empty = msg => html`<div class="dash-empty">${msg}</div>`
noData = pc.length === 0
// precincts exist but every count is still zero (pre-election / zero files)
noVotes = reported.length === 0
noVotesMsg = () => empty(noData ? "No data yet for this contest." : "No votes reported yet for this contest.")
noPres = () => empty(`No 2024 presidential match for ${cur.label} (VoteHub estimated_past_results.csv through the ENR-to-VoteHub crosswalk).`)

// precinct + county points for the history scatter
scatterRows = {
  if (!cur.has_pres) return [];
  const geo = reported
    .filter(d => d.method === "Total" && d.pres_dem_share != null && d.dem_share2 != null)
    .map(d => ({ ...d, level: "Precincts" }));
  const county = d3.rollups(geo, v => ({
    level: "Counties",
    // the geo's county code (st_cbs); the history's county name when there is one
    county: v[0].county === v[0].src ? v[0].geo.split("_").slice(0, 2).join("_") : v[0].county,
    dem_share2: d3.sum(v, d => d.dem) / d3.sum(v, d => d.dem + d.rep),
    pres_dem_share: d3.sum(v, d => d.pres_dem) / d3.sum(v, d => d.pres_dem + d.pres_rep),
    total: d3.sum(v, d => d.total)
  }), d => d.geo.split("_").slice(0, 2).join("_")).map(([, r]) => r);
  return [...geo, ...county];
}

// precinct explorer (controls live in the explorer card toolbar)
// picker groups: [group, [[column, label], ...]]; '22 history only when the contest has a history file
explorerGroups = {
  const yy = cur.hist_year ? `'${String(cur.hist_year).slice(2)}` : "";
  return [
    ["Vote Share", [["dem", "Dem votes"], ["rep", "Rep votes"], ["total", "Total votes"], ["dem_share", "Dem share"], ["rep_share", "Rep share"],
      ["dem_share2", "Dem two-party share"], ["margin", "Margin (D − R)"], ["swing", "Dem two-party swing vs. '24 Pres."]]],
    ["Turnout", [["turnout", "Turnout (votes / L2 registrants)"], ["l2_turnout20", "Turnout '20"], ["l2_turnout22", "Turnout '22"], ["l2_turnout24", "Turnout '24"],
      ["turnout_chg22", "Turnout change vs. '22"], ["turnout_chg24", "Turnout change vs. '24"]]],
    ["L2", [["l2_n", "Registrants"], ["l2_male", "% male"], ["l2_white", "% white"], ["l2_black", "% Black"],
      ["l2_hispanic", "% Hispanic"], ["l2_asian", "% Asian"]]],
    ["Past Votes", [
      ...(cur.has_pres ? [["pres_dem_share", "'24 Pres. Dem two-party share"], ["pres_margin", "'24 Pres. margin (D − R)"]] : []),
      ...(cur.has_hist ? [["hist_dem", `${yy} Dem votes`], ["hist_rep", `${yy} Rep votes`], ["hist_total", `${yy} total votes`],
        ["hist_dem_share", `${yy} Dem share`], ["hist_margin", `${yy} margin (D − R)`]] : [])]]
  ].filter(([, v]) => v.length);
}
explorerLabel = new Map(explorerGroups.flatMap(([, v]) => v))
explorerCols = [...explorerLabel.keys()]
// grouped <select> as a view (Inputs.select has no optgroups)
explorerSelect = (label, value) => {
  const s = html`<select class="form-select">${explorerGroups.map(([g, v]) => html`<optgroup label="${g}">${v.map(([k, l]) =>
    html`<option value=${k}>${l}</option>`)}</optgroup>`)}</select>`;
  s.value = explorerLabel.has(value) ? value : explorerCols[0];
  const form = html`<form class="explorer-pick"><label>${label}</label>${s}</form>`;
  form.value = s.value;
  s.addEventListener("input", () => { form.value = s.value; });
  form.addEventListener("submit", e => e.preventDefault());
  return form;
}
// precincts without an L2 match have null L2 vars and drop out here
explorerRows = reported.filter(d => d.facet === prec_mode && d[prec_x] != null && d[prec_y] != null)
explorerType = k => d3.max(explorerRows, d => d[k]) > 2 ? "sqrt" : "linear"
// shares/proportions (all values in [0, 1]) always get a fixed 0-1 axis
explorerDomain = k => { const [lo, hi] = d3.extent(explorerRows, d => d[k]); return lo >= 0 && hi <= 1 ? [0, 1] : undefined; }
explorerLo = Math.max(d3.min(explorerRows, d => d[prec_x]), d3.min(explorerRows, d => d[prec_y]))
explorerHi = Math.min(d3.max(explorerRows, d => d[prec_x]), d3.max(explorerRows, d => d[prec_y]))
// dashed blue zero line on an axis only when its values fall on both sides of 0
explorerCrosses = k => { const [lo, hi] = d3.extent(explorerRows, d => d[k]); return lo < 0 && hi > 0; }
ZERO_LINE = "#3c78d8"

// Plot specs (no width/height): chart cells pass these into a literal Plot.plot({ key: value }) call.
// Quarto's dashboard autosize only injects card width/height when every option is a plain property (no spread).
timeSpec = (rows, y, opts) => ({
  marginBottom: 30,
  fx: { domain: facets, label: null },
  x: { label: null, ticks: 3 },
  y: { grid: true, label: opts.label, tickFormat: opts.tickFormat, domain: opts.domain },
  color: opts.color,
  marks: [
    Plot.lineY(rows, { fx: "facet", x: "time", y, stroke: opts.stroke, strokeWidth: 2 }),
    Plot.dot(rows, { fx: "facet", x: "time", y, fill: opts.stroke, r: 2 }),
    Plot.ruleX(rows, Plot.pointerX({ fx: "facet", x: "time", stroke: "#999" })),
    Plot.tip(rows, Plot.pointerX({ fx: "facet", x: "time", y, title: d => `${d.series} · ${d.facet}\n${fmtTime(d.time)}\n${opts.tip(d)}` }))
  ]
})

histSpec = (rows, x, label, xticks = 2) => ({
  marginBottom: 40,
  fx: { domain: facets.filter(f => rows.some(d => d.facet === f)), label: null },
  x: { label, tickFormat: "+.0%", ticks: xticks },
  y: { grid: true, label: "Precincts" },
  marks: [
    Plot.rectY(rows, Plot.binX({ y: "count" }, { fx: "facet", x, fill: INK, fillOpacity: 0.7, inset: 1, tip: true })),
    Plot.ruleX([0], { stroke: "#999", strokeDasharray: "4,4" }),
    Plot.ruleX(rows, Plot.groupZ({ x: "median" }, { fx: "facet", x, stroke: "black", strokeWidth: 2 })),
    Plot.ruleY([0])
  ]
})
// export legend for histSpec's marks
histKeys = zero => [
  { mark: "rect", label: "Precincts per bin", opacity: 0.7 },
  { mark: "line", label: "Median precinct", color: "black" },
  { mark: "line", label: zero, color: "#999", width: 1, dash: "4,4" }
]

// ---- Image export ----
// Each chart cell registers its spec here, with legend keys for any marks the color scale doesn't cover;
// the card-header button re-renders it in the MIT Election Lab house style (ggmedsl's theme_medsl(),
// medsl_caption() and add_logo(): Styrene B, centred title, bottom legend, source caption, lab logo strip)
// at a fixed size and saves a high-resolution JPEG on white (opt.format "png" keeps a transparent background,
// "svg" saves a vector SVG; the District Map does). Precinct maps also credit VoteHub for the basemap. The live charts are untouched.
EXPORT_THEME = { return {
  width: 1200, height: 675, scale: 3, format: "jpeg",   // pixels = width/height x scale (maps: height follows the state); "png", "jpeg" or "svg"
  font: "'Styrene B', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif",
  base: 16,   // theme_medsl(base_size); every other size is one of its rel() multiples
  ink: "#000000", subtitle: "#444444", muted: "#666666", grid: "#D0D0D0", background: "#ffffff", pad: 24,
  margin: { top: 30, right: 24, bottom: 48, left: 64 },   // minimum plot margins at the larger font (maps get none)
  source: "MIT Election Data + Science Lab", basemap: "VoteHub",
  dem: "#3791FF", rep: "#F6573E",   // ggmedsl party_colors in place of DEM/REP; null keeps the dashboard's
  logoW: 0.12, logoPad: 0.01        // add_logo() defaults, as fractions of the width
} }
EXPORTS = new Map()
// legend: { swatch, keys } where swatch is the key shape for the color scale's entries and keys are extra
// entries { mark: "rect" | "band" | "line" | "dot" | "ring" | "arrow", label, color, opacity, width, dash, r, dir }
// opt (pages not keyed on the contest, e.g. Redistricting): scope (the key the export button asks for,
// else the contest), sub (subtitle), file (file name prefix), time, basemap (map credit; no VoteHub logo),
// height (px at the theme's width, in place of its fixed height), format (in place of the theme's),
// multi: [{ s, title, suffix }] to save several images from one button
exportable = (name, s, title, legend = {}, opt = {}) => (EXPORTS.set(`${opt.scope ?? cur.key}|${name}`, { s, title: title ?? name, legend, ...opt }), s)

// Styrene B for the canvas text; the rasterized SVG carries its own @font-face (an <img> can't see page fonts)
exportFont = {
  const f = new FontFace("Styrene B", `url(${medsl_font})`);
  document.fonts.add(await f.load());
  return f;
}

exportChart = {
  const T = EXPORT_THEME;
  void exportFont;
  const loadImg = src => { const i = new Image(); i.src = src; return i.decode().then(() => i); };
  const logos = Promise.all([loadImg(medsl_logo), loadImg(votehub_logo)]);
  const recolorMap = new Map(T.dem && T.rep
    ? [[DEM, T.dem], [REP, T.rep], ...d3.zip(marginRange(DEM, REP), marginRange(T.dem, T.rep))].map(([a, b]) => [a.toLowerCase(), b])
    : []);
  const recolor = c => recolorMap.get(String(c).toLowerCase()) ?? c;
  const idb = (op, val) => new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const req = indexedDB.open("cbs-dash-export", 1);
    req.onupgradeneeded = () => req.result.createObjectStore("kv");
    req.onerror = () => reject(req.error);
    req.onsuccess = () => {
      const tx = req.result.transaction("kv", op === "get" ? "readonly" : "readwrite");
      const r = op === "get" ? tx.objectStore("kv").get("dir") : tx.objectStore("kv").put(val, "dir");
      r.onsuccess = () => resolve(r.result);
      r.onerror = () => reject(r.error);
    };
  });
  // folder is picked once (shift-click to re-pick) and remembered; needs Chrome/Edge, otherwise a normal download
  const getDir = async repick => {
    if (!window.showDirectoryPicker) return null;
    let dir = repick ? null : await idb("get").catch(() => null);
    if (dir && (await dir.requestPermission({ mode: "readwrite" })) !== "granted") dir = null;
    if (!dir) {
      dir = await window.showDirectoryPicker({ id: "cbs-dash-export", mode: "readwrite" });
      await idb("put", dir).catch(() => null);
    }
    return dir;
  };
  // a stand-in for the canvas 2D context that records the same drawing calls as SVG elements (the vector
  // export), so both formats share one layout; text is measured on a real canvas
  const svgContext = () => {
    const NS = "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg", XL = "http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink";
    const ruler = document.createElement("canvas").getContext("2d");
    const root = document.createElementNS(NS, "svg");
    const el = (tag, attrs) => {
      const e = document.createElementNS(NS, tag);
      for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(attrs)) if (v != null) k === "href" ? e.setAttributeNS(XL, "xlink:href", v) : e.setAttribute(k, v);
      root.append(e);
      return e;
    };
    const keys = ["fillStyle", "strokeStyle", "lineWidth", "globalAlpha", "font", "textAlign", "textBaseline", "dash"], stack = [];
    let d = "";
    const op = () => g.globalAlpha === 1 ? null : g.globalAlpha;
    const g = {
      fillStyle: "#000000", strokeStyle: "#000000", lineWidth: 1, globalAlpha: 1, font: "10px sans-serif",
      textAlign: "left", textBaseline: "alphabetic", dash: [],
      scale() {},
      save() { stack.push(Object.fromEntries(keys.map(k => [k, g[k]]))); },
      restore() { Object.assign(g, stack.pop()); },
      setLineDash(a) { g.dash = a; },
      measureText(t) { ruler.font = g.font; return ruler.measureText(t); },
      fillRect(x, y, width, height) { el("rect", { x, y, width, height, fill: g.fillStyle, "fill-opacity": op() }); },
      beginPath() { d = ""; },
      moveTo(x, y) { d += `M${x},${y}`; },
      lineTo(x, y) { d += `L${x},${y}`; },
      arc(x, y, r, a0, a1) {   // clockwise, as the canvas default
        const pt = a => `${x + r * Math.cos(a)},${y + r * Math.sin(a)}`;
        d += `${d ? "L" : "M"}${pt(a0)}`;
        d += a1 - a0 >= 2 * Math.PI - 1e-9
          ? `A${r},${r} 0 1 1 ${pt(a0 + Math.PI)}A${r},${r} 0 1 1 ${pt(a0)}Z`
          : `A${r},${r} 0 ${a1 - a0 > Math.PI ? 1 : 0} 1 ${pt(a1)}`;
      },
      fill() { el("path", { d, fill: g.fillStyle, "fill-opacity": op() }); },
      stroke() {
        el("path", { d, fill: "none", stroke: g.strokeStyle, "stroke-width": g.lineWidth, "stroke-opacity": op(),
          "stroke-dasharray": g.dash.length ? g.dash.join(",") : null });
      },
      fillText(t, x, y) {
        const m = g.measureText(t);
        const dy = g.textBaseline === "top" ? (m.emHeightAscent ?? m.fontBoundingBoxAscent ?? 0) : 0;
        el("text", { x, y: y + dy, fill: g.fillStyle, "fill-opacity": op(), style: `font: ${g.font}`,
          "text-anchor": { center: "middle", right: "end", end: "end" }[g.textAlign] ?? "start" }).textContent = t;
      },
      // the plot comes in as its <svg> element and is nested as is (vector); logos as embedded images
      drawImage(img, x, y, width, height) {
        if (img instanceof SVGSVGElement) {
          Object.entries({ x, y, width, height }).forEach(([k, v]) => img.setAttribute(k, v));
          root.append(img);
        } else el("image", { href: img.src, x, y, width, height, preserveAspectRatio: "none" });
      },
      toBlob(W, H) {
        root.setAttribute("xmlns", NS);
        root.setAttribute("xmlns:xlink", XL);
        Object.entries({ width: W, height: H, viewBox: `0 0 ${W} ${H}` }).forEach(([k, v]) => root.setAttribute(k, v));
        const face = document.createElementNS(NS, "style");
        face.textContent = `@font-face { font-family: "Styrene B"; src: url(${medsl_font}) format("truetype"); }`;
        root.prepend(face);
        return new Blob([new XMLSerializer().serializeToString(root)], { type: "image/svg+xml" });
      }
    };
    return g;
  };
  const render = async ({ s, title, legend: lg, sub, basemap, height, format = T.format }) => {
    const [medslLogo, votehubLogo] = await logos;
    const B = T.base, W = T.width, innerW = W - 2 * T.pad;
    const isMap = s.projection != null;
    // a Plot caption would wrap the svg in a <figure>; it goes in the caption block instead
    // (exportCaption, when given, replaces the live one). keys: legend entries a spec builder
    // (modelSpec) carries for its own marks
    const { caption, exportCaption, keys: specKeys = [], ...spec } = s;
    const note = exportCaption ?? caption;
    const vector = format === "svg";
    const c = vector ? null : document.createElement("canvas");
    const g = vector ? svgContext() : c.getContext("2d");
    const font = rel => `400 ${rel * B}px ${T.font}`;
    const measure = (t, rel) => (g.font = font(rel), g.measureText(t).width);
    const lineH = rel => rel * B * 1.25;
    // medsl_wrap(): greedy word wrap to maxW
    const wrap = (t, rel, maxW = innerW) => String(t).split(" ").reduce((lines, w) => {
      const joined = lines.length ? `${lines[lines.length - 1]} ${w}` : w;
      if (lines.length && measure(joined, rel) <= maxW) lines[lines.length - 1] = joined; else lines.push(w);
      return lines;
    }, []);
    const text = (lines, rel, color, x, y, align = "left") => {
      g.font = font(rel); g.fillStyle = color; g.textAlign = align;
      lines.forEach((l, i) => g.fillText(l, x, y + i * lineH(rel)));
      g.textAlign = "left";
      return y + lines.length * lineH(rel);
    };

    // layout first (measuring only), so maps can size the canvas to the state's shape.
    // title and subtitle, centred (plot.title / plot.subtitle)
    const titleLines = wrap(title, 1.4), subLines = wrap(sub ?? `${cur.label} · as of ${fmtTime(cur.time)} ET`, 1);
    const plotTop = T.pad + titleLines.length * lineH(1.4) + 0.75 * B + subLines.length * lineH(1) + B;

    // logo strip under everything (add_logo(position = "bottom-right")); maps add VoteHub to its left
    const lp = T.logoPad * W, logoW = T.logoW * W, logoH = logoW * medslLogo.naturalHeight / medslLogo.naturalWidth;
    const stripH = logoH + 2 * lp;

    // caption, left-aligned: the chart's own note, then the source line
    const capLines = [...(note ? wrap(note, 0.75) : []),
      ...wrap(`Source: ${T.source}${isMap ? `. Basemap: ${basemap ?? T.basemap}` : ""}`, 0.75)];

    // legend at the bottom, centred rows: the color scale, then one key per remaining mark
    const kh = 0.85 * B;
    const drawKey = (k, x, y) => {
      const cy = y + kh / 2;
      g.save();
      g.globalAlpha = k.opacity ?? 1;
      g.fillStyle = g.strokeStyle = recolor(k.color ?? INK);
      if (k.mark === "rect") g.fillRect(x + 12 - kh / 2, y, kh, kh);
      else if (k.mark === "band") g.fillRect(x, cy - 5, 24, 10);
      else if (k.mark === "dot") { g.beginPath(); g.arc(x + 12, cy, k.r ?? 3, 0, 2 * Math.PI); g.fill(); }
      else if (k.mark === "ring") { g.lineWidth = k.width ?? 1.5; g.fillStyle = "#ffffff"; g.beginPath(); g.arc(x + 12, cy, k.r ?? 4, 0, 2 * Math.PI); g.fill(); g.stroke(); }
      else if (k.mark === "arrow") {
        // up-left (dir -1) or up-right (dir 1) at 35°, as on the Shift Map
        const a = (k.dir < 0 ? 215 : -35) * Math.PI / 180, L = 20, x0 = x + 12 - L / 2 * Math.cos(a), y0 = cy - L / 2 * Math.sin(a);
        const [x1, y1] = [x0 + L * Math.cos(a), y0 + L * Math.sin(a)], hd = (t) => [x1 - 6 * Math.cos(a + t), y1 - 6 * Math.sin(a + t)];
        g.lineWidth = k.width ?? 2;
        g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(x0, y0); g.lineTo(x1, y1); g.moveTo(...hd(0.6)); g.lineTo(x1, y1); g.lineTo(...hd(-0.6)); g.stroke();
      }
      else {
        g.lineWidth = k.width ?? 2;
        g.setLineDash(k.dash ? k.dash.split(",").map(Number) : []);
        g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(x, cy); g.lineTo(x + 24, cy); g.stroke();
      }
      g.restore();
    };
    const keyItem = k => ({ w: 30 + measure(k.label, 0.85), h: kh, draw: (x, y) => (drawKey(k, x, y), text([k.label], 0.85, T.ink, x + 30, y)) });
    const items = [];
    const sc = spec.color;
    if (sc?.domain && sc.range) {
      const tw = sc.label ? measure(sc.label, 0.95) + B / 2 : 0;
      const drawTitle = (x, y) => sc.label && text([sc.label], 0.95, T.ink, x, y);
      if (sc.type === "threshold") {
        const bw = 44, tf = sc.tickFormat ?? (d => d), lh = 0.8 * B;
        items.push({ w: tw + bw * sc.range.length, h: kh + 4 + lh, draw: (x, y) => {
          drawTitle(x, y);
          sc.range.forEach((col, i) => { g.fillStyle = recolor(col); g.fillRect(x + tw + i * bw, y, bw, kh); });
          sc.domain.forEach((d, i) => text([tf(d)], 0.8, T.ink, x + tw + (i + 1) * bw, y + kh + 4, "center"));
        } });
      } else {
        if (sc.label) items.push({ w: tw, h: kh, draw: drawTitle });
        sc.domain.forEach((d, i) => items.push(keyItem({ mark: lg.swatch ?? "rect", label: String(d), color: sc.range[i] })));
      }
    }
    [...(lg.keys ?? []), ...specKeys].filter(Boolean).forEach(k => items.push(keyItem(k)));
    const rows = [];
    for (const it of items) {
      const r = rows[rows.length - 1];
      if (r && r.w + B + it.w <= innerW) { r.items.push(it); r.w += B + it.w; } else rows.push({ items: [it], w: it.w });
    }
    rows.forEach(r => r.h = d3.max(r.items, it => it.h));
    const legendH = rows.length ? d3.sum(rows, r => r.h) + (rows.length - 1) * 6 : 0;
    const footH = stripH + capLines.length * lineH(0.75) + 0.75 * B + (rows.length ? legendH + B / 2 : 0);

    // maps get the projected state's aspect ratio at full width; other charts the theme's fixed size
    let H = height ?? T.height;
    if (isMap) {
      const p = s.projection;
      const [[x0, y0], [x1, y1]] = d3.geoPath(d3.geoConicEqualArea().parallels(p.parallels).rotate(p.rotate)).bounds(p.domain);
      H = Math.round(plotTop + innerW * (y1 - y0) / (x1 - x0) + footH);
    }
    const plotH = H - plotTop - footH;

    if (c) { c.width = W * T.scale; c.height = H * T.scale; }
    g.scale(T.scale, T.scale);
    // transparent background, except JPEG (no alpha); white marks keep their own fill
    if (format === "jpeg") { g.fillStyle = T.background; g.fillRect(0, 0, W, H); }
    g.textBaseline = "top";
    text(titleLines, 1.4, T.ink, W / 2, T.pad, "center");
    text(subLines, 1, T.subtitle, W / 2, T.pad + titleLines.length * lineH(1.4) + 0.75 * B, "center");
    const stripTop = H - stripH;
    g.drawImage(medslLogo, W - lp - logoW, stripTop + lp, logoW, logoH);
    if (isMap && !basemap) {
      const vw = logoH * votehubLogo.naturalWidth / votehubLogo.naturalHeight;
      g.drawImage(votehubLogo, W - lp - logoW - 2 * B - vw, stripTop + lp, vw, logoH);
    }
    const capTop = stripTop - capLines.length * lineH(0.75);
    text(capLines, 0.75, T.muted, T.pad, capTop);
    let y = capTop - 0.75 * B - legendH;
    for (const r of rows) {
      let x = (W - r.w) / 2;
      for (const it of r.items) { it.draw(x, y + (r.h - it.h) / 2); x += it.w + B; }
      y += r.h + 6;
    }

    // the plot itself: theme_minimal-style axes (no ticks, light major grid)
    const m = k => isMap ? 0 : Math.max(spec[`margin${k}`] ?? 0, T.margin[k.toLowerCase()]);
    const axis = a => a && { ...a, tickSize: 0 };
    const svg = Plot.plot({
      ...spec, x: axis(spec.x), y: axis(spec.y), color: sc && { ...sc, legend: false }, width: innerW, height: plotH,
      marginTop: m("Top"), marginRight: m("Right"), marginBottom: m("Bottom"), marginLeft: m("Left"),
      style: { fontFamily: T.font, fontSize: `${0.85 * B}px`, color: T.ink, background: "transparent", overflow: "visible" }
    });
    svg.setAttribute("xmlns", "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg");
    svg.querySelectorAll('[aria-label$="-grid"]').forEach(e => (e.setAttribute("stroke", T.grid), e.setAttribute("stroke-opacity", 1)));
    svg.querySelectorAll('[aria-label$="-axis label"]').forEach(e => e.setAttribute("font-size", B));
    svg.querySelectorAll('[aria-label="fx-axis tick label"]').forEach(e => e.setAttribute("font-size", 0.95 * B));
    svg.querySelectorAll("[fill], [stroke]").forEach(e => ["fill", "stroke"].forEach(a => e.hasAttribute(a) && e.setAttribute(a, recolor(e.getAttribute(a)))));
    const face = document.createElementNS("http://www.w3.org/2000/svg", "style");
    face.textContent = `@font-face { font-family: "Styrene B"; src: url(${medsl_font}) format("truetype"); }`;
    svg.prepend(face);
    if (vector) {
      g.drawImage(svg, T.pad, plotTop, innerW, plotH);
      return g.toBlob(W, H);
    }
    const img = await loadImg("data:image/svg+xml;charset=utf-8," + encodeURIComponent(new XMLSerializer().serializeToString(svg)));
    g.drawImage(img, T.pad, plotTop, innerW, plotH);
    return new Promise(resolve => c.toBlob(resolve, `image/${format}`, 0.95));
  };
  // only: export just the entry.multi item with this suffix (the District Map's 2024 / 2026 buttons)
  return async (name, repick = false, scope = cur.key, only = null) => {
    const entry = EXPORTS.get(`${scope}|${name}`);
    if (!entry) return "Nothing to export for this chart.";
    const stamp = new Date(entry.time ?? cur.time ?? Date.now()).toISOString().slice(0, 16).replace(/[-:]/g, "").replace("T", "-");
    const slug = x => x.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, "-");
    let dir = null;
    try { dir = await getDir(repick); } catch (e) { if (e.name === "AbortError") return "Cancelled."; console.warn(e); }
    // one image, or one per entry.multi item (same projection and text, so the same size)
    const files = [], blobs = [];
    const items = entry.multi ? entry.multi.filter(it => only == null || it.suffix === only) : [entry];
    if (items.length === 0) return "Nothing to export for this chart.";
    for (const it of items) {
      const fmt = it.format ?? entry.format ?? T.format;
      const file = `${entry.file ?? cur.key}_${slug(name)}${it.suffix ? `_${it.suffix}` : ""}_${stamp}.${fmt === "jpeg" ? "jpg" : fmt}`;
      const blob = await render({ ...entry, ...it });
      if (dir) {
        const w = await (await dir.getFileHandle(file, { create: true })).createWritable();
        await w.write(blob);
        await w.close();
      } else blobs.push([file, blob]);
      files.push(file);
    }
    // downloads: all rendered first, then started a moment apart (browsers drop a second download
    // started in the same instant; Chrome may ask once to allow multiple downloads)
    for (const [i, [file, blob]] of blobs.entries()) {
      if (i) await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 600));
      const a = html`<a download=${file} href=${URL.createObjectURL(blob)} hidden>`;
      document.body.append(a);
      a.click();
      a.remove();
      setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(a.href), 60000);
    }
    return `${dir ? `Saved ${dir.name}/` : "Downloaded "}${files.join(", ")}`;
  };
}

// one button per chart card header; exports whichever tab is showing
exportButtons = {
  // charts on the Redistricting page are registered under its state (rdScope), not the contest
  const scopeOf = h => h.closest("#redistricting") ? rdScope : cur.key;
  const add = (header, nameFn, title = "Save chart image (shift-click: choose folder)", label = "", only = null) => {
    const b = html`<button type="button" class="btn btn-sm dash-export" title=${title}><i class="bi bi-download"></i>${label ? ` ${label}` : ""}</button>`;
    b.onclick = async e => {
      b.disabled = true;
      const msg = await exportChart(nameFn(), e.shiftKey, scopeOf(header), only).catch(err => (console.error(err), `Export failed: ${err.message}`));
      b.disabled = false;
      b.title = msg;
      b.classList.add("dash-export-done");
      setTimeout(() => b.classList.remove("dash-export-done"), 1500);
    };
    header.append(b);
  };
  document.querySelectorAll(".dash-export").forEach(b => b.remove());
  document.querySelectorAll(".card.tabset > .card-header").forEach(h => add(h, () => h.querySelector(".nav-link.active")?.dataset.value));
  const ex = document.querySelector(".card-toolbar");
  if (ex) add(ex, () => "Precinct Explorer");
  // the Redistricting map: one button per map image
  document.querySelectorAll(".card:not(.tabset) > .card-header").forEach(h => {
    if (h.textContent.trim() !== "District Map") return;
    for (const yr of ["2024", "2026"]) add(h, () => "District Map", `Save the ${yr} map as SVG (shift-click: choose folder)`, yr, `${yr}-map`);
  });
  return exportChart;
}
```

```{ojs boxes}
{
  const box = (title, value, sub, cls = "", sub2 = "") => html`<div class="dbox ${cls}">
    <div class="dbox-title">${title}</div>
    <div class="dbox-value">${value}</div>
    <div class="dbox-sub">${sub}</div>
    ${sub2 ? html`<div class="dbox-sub">${sub2}</div>` : ""}
  </div>`;
  // before the latest data: vote totals from the summaries at "As of" (no precinct snapshots back then)
  const tLast = d3.max(tsRowsScraped, d => +d.time);
  const at = f => tsRowsScraped.find(d => +d.time === tLast && d.facet === f) ?? { dem: 0, rep: 0, total: 0 };
  const c = asofLatest ? cur : { ...cur, time: tLast ?? null, total: at("Total").total, dem_votes: at("Total").dem, rep_votes: at("Total").rep,
    eday: cur.eday == null ? null : at(METHOD_LABELS.eday).total };
  const yy = c.hist_year ? `'${String(c.hist_year).slice(2)}` : null;
  const ofHist = (x, h) => x != null && h > 0 && yy ? `${pct(x / h)} of ${yy}` : "";
  const two = c.dem_votes + c.rep_votes;
  const reportedGeo = c.n_complete + c.n_partial;
  // top_model's latest scraped-geo vote projection; blank if not modeled or its latest run didn't fit
  const isTop = d => d.model === top_model || `${d.model_base}/${d.model_spec}/${d.model_interval}` === top_model;
  const topStatus = d3.greatest(MS.filter(d => d.key === sel && isTop(d) && +new Date(d.time) <= asofT), d => +new Date(d.time));
  const topRows = MP.filter(d => d.key === sel && isTop(d) && d.geo === "scraped" && d.pred_type === "vote" && +d.time <= asofT);
  const topTime = d3.max(topRows, d => +d.time);
  const topPred = p => topRows.find(d => +d.time === topTime && d.party === p)?.pred;
  const [pd, pr] = [topPred("dem"), topPred("rep")];
  const fits = top_model && pd != null && pr != null && pd + pr > 0 && (!topStatus || /^ok/.test(topStatus.status));
  const proj = v => fits ? html`<span title=${`${top_model} · ${fmtTime(new Date(topTime))}`}>Proj. ${fmt(Math.round(v))} · ${pct(v / (pd + pr))}</span>` : "";
  return html`<div class="dbox-row">
    ${box("Last Updated", fmtTime(c.time), c.n_juris > 1 ? html`<span title=${c.juris}>ET · ${c.n_juris} jurisdictions pooled</span>` : `ET · ${c.juris}`)}
    ${box("Precincts Reported", c.n_geo ? `${fmt(reportedGeo)} / ${fmt(c.n_geo)}` : "—",
      c.n_geo ? `${fmt(c.n_complete)} done · ${fmt(c.n_partial)} partial${asofLatest ? "" : " · latest"}` : "")}
    ${box("Total Votes Reported", fmt(c.total), ofHist(c.total, c.hist_total))}
    ${box("EDay Votes Reported", c.eday == null ? "—" : fmt(c.eday), c.eday == null ? "No Election Day split" : ofHist(c.eday, c.hist_eday))}
    ${box(c.dem_name ?? "Democrat", fmt(c.dem_votes), two > 0 ? `${pct(c.dem_votes / two)} of two-party` : "", "dbox-dem", proj(pd))}
    ${box(c.rep_name ?? "Republican", fmt(c.rep_votes), two > 0 ? `${pct(c.rep_votes / two)} of two-party` : "", "dbox-rep", proj(pr))}
  </div>`;
}
```

```{ojs results-places}
// value = { all }: Total Votes / Vote Count / Vote Share add CBS's county counts for the
// counties we don't scrape. Only toggleable in PARTIAL_STATES (hidden there when the contest
// has no CBS snapshots); elsewhere the scrape is already statewide, so it shows checked and disabled.
viewof places = {
  const form = html`<form class="model-ctl">
    <label title="Add CBS county results for the counties we don't scrape precinct by precinct (Total Votes, Vote Count, Vote Share). CBS's per-method counts can fall short of its county totals, and counties CBS reports as Advance add nothing to Early or Mail, so only the Total facet is complete.">
      <input type="checkbox" name="all" class="form-check-input"> Statewide prediction</label>
  </form>`;
  const { all } = form.elements;
  if (partialState) {
    form.hidden = tsPlacesAll.length === 0;
    all.checked = placesMemo.all === true;
  } else {
    all.checked = true;
    all.disabled = true;
    form.querySelector("label").title = `We scrape every county in ${cur.state}, so the results are already statewide.`;
  }
  const update = () => { form.value = { all: all.checked }; if (partialState) placesMemo.all = all.checked; };
  form.addEventListener("input", update);
  form.addEventListener("submit", e => e.preventDefault());
  update();
  return form;
}
```

# Models

```{ojs model-setup}
//| output: false

// enightmodels predictions for the selected contest (read_model_results() in functions.R)
mpc = MP.filter(d => d.key === sel)
// test data only (make_dashboard_test_data.R): the sim's final truth, drawn as a reference line
truthc = transpose(truth).find(d => d.key === sel) ?? null
msc = MS.filter(d => d.key === sel)
// models with predictions first, then ones that only appear in status (failed runs)
modelsOk = [...new Set(mpc.map(d => d.model))].sort()
modelList = [...modelsOk, ...[...new Set(msc.map(d => d.model))].filter(m => !modelsOk.includes(m)).sort()]
noModels = mpc.length === 0
// model name -> { base, spec, interval, specDefault, intervalDefault } (dash_model_parts() in functions.R)
modelParts = {
  const m = new Map();
  for (const d of [...mpc, ...msc]) if (!m.has(d.model))
    m.set(d.model, { base: d.model_base ?? d.model, spec: d.model_spec ?? "default", interval: d.model_interval ?? "default",
                     specDefault: d.spec_default ?? false, intervalDefault: d.interval_default ?? false });
  return m;
}

// picker text for the demographic specs (scripts/model/live/R/demos.R) and intervals (R/results.R):
// [dropdown label, hover description]; codes not listed show as-is. Listed order is dropdown order.
SPEC_LABELS = {
  return {
    ratio: ["No covariates", "Expected votes only"],
    strat_g: ["Region", "Effect for each CBS region (geostratum)"],
    strat_d: ["Majority race", "Effect for each precinct majority-race group (stratum_demo: white, Hispanic, Black, Asian, or mixed)"],
    strat_dg: ["Majority race + region", "Majority-race and CBS-region group effects"],
    strat_d_cov: ["Majority race + '24 vote, age, white educ.", "Majority race; '24 Dem two-party share and its square; % aged 18-29 and 65+; % white college and % white non-college"],
    strat_dg_cov: ["Majority race + region + '24 vote, age, white educ.", "Majority race and CBS region; '24 Dem two-party share and its square; % aged 18-29 and 65+; % white college and % white non-college"],
    tpsob: ["Spline: '24 vote, age, educ., race", "43-term thin-plate spline basis of '24 Dem share, % 18-29 and 65+, % white college and non-college, % Black, % Hispanic"],
    tpsob_g: ["Spline: '24 vote, age, educ., race + region", "43-term thin-plate spline basis of '24 Dem share, % 18-29 and 65+, % white college and non-college, % Black, % Hispanic; plus CBS region"],
    medsl_cov: ["MEDSL: '24 vote, turnout, age, sex, race", "'24 Dem two-party share; 2022 and 2024 turnout (L2); % 65+; % male; YouGov % Black and % Hispanic"]
  }
}
INTERVAL_LABELS = {
  return {
    bootstrap: ["County bootstrap", "County bootstrap of the swing model"],
    credible: ["Posterior", "Equal-tailed interval of the posterior draws"],
    conf_seq: ["Confidence sequence", "Confidence sequence on prior vs. posterior race totals"],
    conformal: ["Conformal (approx.)", "Approximate split-conformal interval on fitted cell shares"],
    none: ["None", "No interval"]
  }
}
INTERVAL_SHORT = { return { bootstrap: "Bootstrap", credible: "Posterior", conf_seq: "Conf. seq.", conformal: "Conformal", none: "None" } }
specLabel = s => SPEC_LABELS[s]?.[0] ?? s
intervalLabel = i => INTERVAL_LABELS[i]?.[0] ?? i
// "approx_conform_95" -> "95%"
confLevel = c => { const m = /_(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)$/.exec(c ?? ""); return m ? `${m[1]}%` : ""; }
modelText = m => { const p = modelParts.get(m); return p ? `${p.base} · ${specLabel(p.spec)} · ${intervalLabel(p.interval)}` : m; }
modelTitle = m => { const p = modelParts.get(m); return p ? `${SPEC_LABELS[p.spec]?.[1] ?? p.spec}\n${INTERVAL_LABELS[p.interval]?.[1] ?? p.interval}\n[${m}]` : m; }

noModelsMsg = () => empty(html`<div>No model results for ${cur.label}.</div>
  ${msc.length ? html`<div class="model-status-list">${msc.map(d => html`<div><b>${d.model}</b>: ${d.status}</div>`)}</div>` : ""}`)

GEO_LABELS = { return { scraped: "Scraped", all: "Statewide (all)" } }
partyName = p => p === "dem" ? (cur.dem_name ?? "Dem") : (cur.rep_name ?? "Rep")
modelColor = { return { type: "categorical", domain: [partyName("dem"), partyName("rep")], range: [DEM, REP], legend: true } }

// run times across every model for the contest
runTimes = [...new Set(mpc.map(d => +d.time))].sort((a, b) => a - b)

etOffset = ms => {
  const p = Object.fromEntries(new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-US", { timeZone: "America/New_York", hourCycle: "h23",
    year: "numeric", month: "2-digit", day: "2-digit", hour: "2-digit", minute: "2-digit", second: "2-digit" })
    .formatToParts(ms).map(x => [x.type, x.value]));
  return Date.UTC(+p.year, p.month - 1, +p.day, +p.hour, +p.minute, +p.second) - Math.floor(ms / 1000) * 1000;
}

// last "All places" choice (Results toolbar); no inputs, so it survives contest changes
placesMemo = { return {} }
// last model-control choices; this cell has no inputs, so it survives contest changes and mctl restores from it
mctlMemo = { return {} }

model_pick = mctl.model
// the global "As of", snapped up to the first run: before it there is nothing to show
asof = runTimes.length ? Math.min(Math.max(asofT, runTimes[0]), runTimes.at(-1)) : asofT
hasAll = mpc.some(d => d.model === model_pick && d.geo === "all")
modelRows = mpc
  .filter(d => d.model === model_pick && (d.geo === "scraped" || (d.geo === "all" && mctl.all)))
  .filter(d => +d.time <= asof)
  .map(d => ({ ...d, series: `${partyName(d.party)} · ${GEO_LABELS[d.geo] ?? d.geo}`, pname: partyName(d.party) }))
  .sort((a, b) => a.time - b.time)

// turnout: every party's predicted votes summed per run, with the race total's interval when
// the model gives one (the turnout table; the candidates' bounds don't add up to it)
turnoutRows = d3.rollups(modelRows.filter(d => d.pred_type === "vote"),
  v => { const b = MT.get(`${sel}|${model_pick}|${v[0].geo}|${+v[0].time}`);
         return { time: v[0].time, geo: v[0].geo, pct_rep: v[0].pct_rep, pred: d3.sum(v, d => d.pred), rep: d3.sum(v, d => d.rep),
                  pred_min: b?.pred_min ?? null, pred_max: b?.pred_max ?? null,
                  series: `Total · ${GEO_LABELS[v[0].geo] ?? v[0].geo}` }; },
  d => d.geo, d => +d.time).flatMap(([, g]) => g.map(([, r]) => r)).sort((a, b) => a.time - b.time)
  .map(d => ({ ...d, cbs: cbsAt(d.geo, +d.time) }))

// CBS's expected total vote for the race (statewide, and summed over the scraped counties),
// a step series between the first model run and "As of". Per-method rows (CBSX method !=
// "total") are kept in the data for a by-method plot later.
cbsExp = CBSX.filter(d => d.key === sel && d.method === "total")
cbsAt = (geo, t) => d3.least(cbsExp.filter(d => d.geo === geo && +d.time <= t), d => -d.time)?.expected ?? null
cbsRows = !runTimes.length ? [] : ["scraped", "all"].filter(g => g === "scraped" || mctl.all).flatMap(g => {
  const t0 = runTimes[0];
  const pts = [...new Set([t0, ...cbsExp.filter(d => d.geo === g && +d.time > t0 && +d.time <= asof).map(d => +d.time), asof])]
    .sort((a, b) => a - b);
  return pts.map(t => ({ time: new Date(t), geo: g, expected: cbsAt(g, t), series: `CBS expected · ${GEO_LABELS[g] ?? g}` }))
    .filter(d => d.expected != null);
})
CBS_COLOR = "#e8590c"

// solid line = prediction, ribbon = interval, dotted = reported; "all" draws dashed with a lighter ribbon
modelSpec = (rows, opts) => {
  const geo = g => rows.filter(d => d.geo === g);
  const marks = [];
  for (const g of ["scraped", "all"]) {
    const r = geo(g);
    if (r.length === 0) continue;
    const dash = g === "all" ? "6,3" : null;
    marks.push(
      Plot.areaY(r.filter(d => d.pred_min != null && d.pred_max != null), { x: "time", y1: "pred_min", y2: "pred_max", z: "series", fill: opts.stroke, fillOpacity: g === "all" ? 0.08 : 0.18, curve: "monotone-x" }),
      Plot.lineY(r, { x: "time", y: "rep", z: "series", stroke: opts.stroke, strokeWidth: 1, strokeDasharray: "1,3", strokeOpacity: 0.8 }),
      Plot.lineY(r, { x: "time", y: "pred", z: "series", stroke: opts.stroke, strokeWidth: 2, strokeDasharray: dash }),
      Plot.dot(r, { x: "time", y: "pred", fill: opts.stroke, r: 2 })
    );
  }
  if (opts.rule != null) marks.push(Plot.ruleY([opts.rule], { stroke: "#999", strokeDasharray: "4,4" }));
  if (opts.extra) marks.push(...opts.extra);
  // final truth (test data only): rows of { y, pname }, labelled at the right edge
  if (opts.truth?.length) marks.push(
    Plot.ruleY(opts.truth, { y: "y", stroke: opts.stroke, strokeWidth: 1.5, strokeOpacity: 0.7 }),
    Plot.text(opts.truth, { y: "y", frameAnchor: "right", textAnchor: "end", text: () => "final", fill: opts.stroke, dy: -6, fontSize: 9 })
  );
  marks.push(
    Plot.ruleX(rows, Plot.pointerX({ x: "time", stroke: "#999" })),
    Plot.tip(rows, Plot.pointerX({ x: "time", y: "pred", title: d => `${d.series}\n${fmtTime(d.time)} · ${pct(d.pct_rep)} reporting\n` +
      `Predicted ${opts.fmt(d.pred)}${d.pred_min != null ? ` (${opts.fmt(d.pred_min)} to ${opts.fmt(d.pred_max)})` : ""}\nReported ${opts.fmt(d.rep)}` +
      (d.cbs != null ? `\nCBS expected ${opts.fmt(d.cbs)}` : "") }))
  );
  return {
    marginBottom: 30,
    keys: [
      { mark: "line", label: "Predicted" },
      { mark: "line", label: "Reported", width: 1, dash: "1,3" },
      rows.some(d => d.geo === "all") && { mark: "line", label: `Predicted: ${GEO_LABELS.all}`, dash: "6,3" },
      opts.rule != null && { mark: "line", label: opts.fmt(opts.rule), color: "#999", width: 1, dash: "4,4" },
      ...(opts.extraKeys ?? [])
    ],
    x: { label: null, ticks: 5 },
    y: { grid: true, label: opts.label, tickFormat: opts.tickFormat },
    color: opts.color,
    marks
  };
}

// ---- summary table: each model's latest scraped-geo run at or before "As of" ----
summaryRows = {
  const byModel = d3.group(mpc.filter(d => d.geo === "scraped" && +d.time <= asof), d => d.model);
  return modelsOk.filter(m => byModel.has(m)).map(m => {
    const v = byModel.get(m);
    const t = d3.max(v, d => +d.time);
    const run = v.filter(d => +d.time === t);
    const sh = p => run.find(d => d.pred_type === "share" && d.party === p);
    const [dm, rp] = [sh("dem"), sh("rep")];
    const two = (a, b) => a != null && b != null && a + b > 0 ? a / (a + b) : null;
    const p = modelParts.get(m);
    return {
      model: m, base: p.base, spec: p.spec, interval: p.interval, time: t,
      conf: run.find(d => d.model_conf != null)?.model_conf ?? null,
      d2: two(dm?.pred, rp?.pred),
      // two-party bounds from the share bounds (exact when the shares split a two-party interval)
      lo: two(dm?.pred_min, rp?.pred_max), hi: two(dm?.pred_max, rp?.pred_min),
      turnout: d3.sum(run.filter(d => d.pred_type === "vote"), d => d.pred),
      tlo: MT.get(`${sel}|${m}|scraped|${t}`)?.pred_min ?? null, thi: MT.get(`${sel}|${m}|scraped|${t}`)?.pred_max ?? null,
      pct_rep: run[0].pct_rep
    };
  }).sort((a, b) => d3.ascending(a.base, b.base) || d3.ascending(Object.keys(SPEC_LABELS).indexOf(a.spec), Object.keys(SPEC_LABELS).indexOf(b.spec)) ||
                    d3.ascending(Object.keys(INTERVAL_LABELS).indexOf(a.interval), Object.keys(INTERVAL_LABELS).indexOf(b.interval)));
}

// ---- precinct maps (VoteHub units; geometry from scripts/util/make_dashboard_geo.R) ----
// fetched once per state at view time from geo_url, not embedded in the page; county and
// state outlines ({st}_counties.json, scripts/util/make_dashboard_counties.R) are optional
geoCache = new Map()
geoData = {
  const st = cur.state.toLowerCase();
  const get = f => fetch(`${geo_url}/${f}.json`).then(r => r.ok ? r.json() : null).catch(e => (console.warn(e), null));
  if (!geoCache.has(st)) geoCache.set(st, Promise.all([get(st), get(`${st}_counties`)])
    .then(([fc, cty]) => fc && prepGeo(fc, cty))
    .catch(e => (console.warn(e), null)));
  return geoCache.get(st);
}
// d3 wants clockwise outer rings; flip any polygon that comes out covering the globe.
// Projection centred on the state (AK crosses the antimeridian), fit to the state outline
// when there is one, so states we scrape only in part show whole.
prepGeo = (fc, cty) => {
  const fix = poly => d3.geoArea({ type: "Polygon", coordinates: poly }) > 2 * Math.PI ? poly.map(r => r.slice().reverse()) : poly;
  const prep = fc => fc.features.filter(f => ["Polygon", "MultiPolygon"].includes(f.geometry?.type)).map(f => {
    const g = f.geometry;
    const coordinates = g.type === "Polygon" ? fix(g.coordinates) : g.coordinates.map(fix);
    return { type: "Feature", id: f.properties.id, properties: f.properties, geometry: { type: g.type, coordinates } };
  });
  const features = prep(fc);
  const outlines = cty ? prep(cty) : [];
  const counties = outlines.filter(f => f.id !== "state");
  const state = outlines.find(f => f.id === "state") ?? null;
  const [lon0, lat0] = state ? d3.geoCentroid(state)
    : [d3.median(features, f => f.properties.cx > 0 ? f.properties.cx - 360 : f.properties.cx), d3.median(features, f => f.properties.cy)];
  const domain = state ?? { type: "FeatureCollection", features };
  return { features, byId: new Map(features.map(f => [f.id, f])), counties, countyById: new Map(counties.map(f => [f.id, f])), state,
           projection: { type: "conic-equal-area", parallels: [lat0 - 4, lat0 + 4], rotate: [-lon0, 0], domain } };
}
// county and state outlines, drawn over the precincts on both maps
outlineMarks = g => [
  Plot.geo(g.counties, { fill: "none", stroke: "#868e96", strokeWidth: 0.6 }),
  ...(g.state ? [Plot.geo([g.state], { fill: "none", stroke: INK, strokeWidth: 1.2 })] : [])
]
// capital (cap) and major cities per state: [name, lon, lat, cap, anchor]; anchor "end" puts the
// label left of the point, for cities near the right edge of the state. Block form, not ({...}):
// dashboard autosize regenerates every cell and drops those parentheses, which breaks the chunk
CITIES = { return {
  AK: [["Juneau", -134.42, 58.30, true, "end"], ["Anchorage", -149.90, 61.22], ["Fairbanks", -147.72, 64.84]],
  CA: [["Sacramento", -121.49, 38.58, true], ["San Francisco", -122.42, 37.77, false, "end"], ["San Jose", -121.89, 37.34],
       ["Los Angeles", -118.24, 34.05], ["San Diego", -117.16, 32.72]],
  FL: [["Tallahassee", -84.28, 30.44, true], ["Jacksonville", -81.66, 30.33, false, "end"], ["Orlando", -81.38, 28.54],
       ["Tampa", -82.46, 27.95, false, "end"], ["Miami", -80.19, 25.76, false, "end"]],
  GA: [["Atlanta", -84.39, 33.75, true], ["Augusta", -81.97, 33.47, false, "end"], ["Columbus", -84.99, 32.46],
       ["Savannah", -81.10, 32.08, false, "end"]],
  MI: [["Lansing", -84.56, 42.73, true], ["Detroit", -83.05, 42.33, false, "end"], ["Grand Rapids", -85.67, 42.96, false, "end"]],
  MN: [["Minneapolis", -93.27, 44.98], ["Duluth", -92.10, 46.79, false, "end"], ["Rochester", -92.46, 44.02]],
  NC: [["Raleigh", -78.64, 35.78, true], ["Charlotte", -80.84, 35.23], ["Greensboro", -79.79, 36.07], ["Asheville", -82.55, 35.60]],
  NE: [["Lincoln", -96.68, 40.81, true], ["Omaha", -95.94, 41.26, false, "end"]],
  OH: [["Columbus", -83.00, 39.96, true], ["Cleveland", -81.69, 41.50], ["Cincinnati", -84.51, 39.10], ["Toledo", -83.54, 41.65]],
  PA: [["Harrisburg", -76.88, 40.27, true], ["Philadelphia", -75.17, 39.95, false, "end"], ["Pittsburgh", -80.00, 40.44]],
  TX: [["Austin", -97.74, 30.27, true], ["Dallas", -96.80, 32.78], ["Houston", -95.37, 29.76], ["San Antonio", -98.49, 29.42, false, "end"],
       ["El Paso", -106.49, 31.76]]
} }
// city points and labels, the last marks on every map so they sit over the arrows and circles.
// The text has no font family or size of its own: it inherits the page font live and Styrene B
// in exports. mapZoom moves both with the map but keeps their size.
cityMarks = st => {
  const c = (CITIES[st] ?? []).map(([name, lon, lat, cap = false, anchor = "start"]) => ({ name, lon, lat, cap, anchor }));
  // constant options only: an r or symbol channel would bring in a scale (the Remaining Vote Map has its own r)
  // aria-label "city" on every point and label is how mapZoom finds them
  const opts = { x: "lon", y: "lat", ariaLabel: () => "city", pointerEvents: "none", fill: "#212529", stroke: "white" };
  return [true, false].flatMap(cap => [
    Plot.dot(c.filter(d => d.cap === cap), { ...opts, symbol: cap ? "star" : "circle", r: cap ? 4.5 : 2.5, strokeWidth: 1 }),
    ...["start", "end"].map(a => Plot.text(c.filter(d => d.cap === cap && d.anchor === a), { ...opts, text: "name", textAnchor: a,
      dx: a === "start" ? 6 : -6, fontWeight: cap ? 700 : 500, strokeWidth: 3, strokeOpacity: 0.9, paintOrder: "stroke" }))
  ]);
}
mresc = MRES.filter(d => d.key === sel)
mprecc = MPREC.filter(d => d.key === sel && d.model === model_pick)
mprecRun = MPRECRUN.find(d => d.key === sel && d.model === model_pick)
mctyc = MCTY.filter(d => d.key === sel)
// Shift Map basemap (shift_base): L2 share per VoteHub unit, in fixed bins
mdemoc = new Map(MDEMO.filter(d => d.state === cur.state).map(d => [d.unit_id, d]))
DEMO_RACE_BINS = [0.05, 0.15, 0.3, 0.5, 0.7]
DEMO_VARS = { return {
  l2_white: { label: "% white", bins: DEMO_RACE_BINS },
  l2_black: { label: "% Black", bins: DEMO_RACE_BINS },
  l2_hispanic: { label: "% Hispanic", bins: DEMO_RACE_BINS },
  l2_asian: { label: "% Asian", bins: DEMO_RACE_BINS },
  l2_male: { label: "% male", bins: [0.44, 0.46, 0.48, 0.5, 0.52] }
} }
// Shift Map basemap picker: none (default) or an L2 share per precinct. Built here and moved into the
// Shift Map tab's card body (top right, beside Reset), so the map cell keeps its literal Plot.plot({...})
viewof shift_base = {
  const s = Inputs.select(new Map([["None", ""], ...Object.entries(DEMO_VARS).map(([k, v]) => [v.label, k])]),
    { value: "", label: "Basemap" });
  s.classList.add("shift-base");
  s.querySelector("select").classList.add("form-select", "form-select-sm");
  const place = () => { const body = document.querySelector('[data-title="Shift Map"]'); if (body && s.parentElement !== body) body.append(s); return !!body; };
  if (!place()) { const obs = new MutationObserver(() => place() && obs.disconnect()); obs.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true }); invalidation.then(() => obs.disconnect()); }
  return s;
}
// light-to-dark purple, away from the arrows' party colors and the grey of units with no L2 match
demoColor = k => ({
  type: "threshold", domain: DEMO_VARS[k].bins, legend: true, label: DEMO_VARS[k].label,
  tickFormat: d3.format(".0%"), range: d3.quantize(d3.interpolateRgb("#f2f0f7", "#54278f"), DEMO_VARS[k].bins.length + 1)
})

// two-party Dem margin bins: R+60, R+30, R+10, even, D+10, D+30, D+60
MARGIN_BINS = [-0.6, -0.3, -0.1, 0, 0.1, 0.3, 0.6]
marginColor = { return {
  type: "threshold", domain: MARGIN_BINS, legend: true, label: "Two-party margin",
  tickFormat: d => d === 0 ? "Even" : `${d < 0 ? "R" : "D"}+${Math.round(Math.abs(d) * 100)}`,
  range: marginRange(DEM, REP)
} }
MAP_BLANK = "#e9ecef"
// Plot.vector shape: Plot's "arrow" scales its head with the length; this one's head is fixed
ARROW = { return { draw(c, l) { c.moveTo(0, 0); c.lineTo(0, -l); c.moveTo(-3.5, -l + 5); c.lineTo(0, -l); c.lineTo(3.5, -l + 5); } } }

// zoom (wheel / pinch / double-click) and pan (drag) on every map (className "dash-map"); attached
// from here so the map cells keep the literal Plot.plot({...}) that dashboard autosize needs.
// Lines keep their width, circles grow only with the square root of the zoom, and arrows
// (Plot.vector) move with their precinct but keep their length.
mapZoom = {
  const init = el => {
    el.dataset.zoom = "1";
    const svg = [el, ...el.querySelectorAll("svg")].find(x => x.tagName === "svg" && x.querySelector('g[aria-label="geo"]'));
    if (!svg) return;
    // city points and labels, and the Redistricting map's district labels: moved, not scaled
    const city = '[aria-label="city"], [aria-label="cd-label"]';
    const layers = [...svg.querySelectorAll(':scope > g[aria-label="geo"], :scope > g[aria-label="dot"]')].filter(g => !g.querySelector(city));
    svg.querySelectorAll(`g[aria-label="geo"] path, g[aria-label="dot"] circle:not(${city})`).forEach(x => x.setAttribute("vector-effect", "non-scaling-stroke"));
    const dots = [...svg.querySelectorAll(`g[aria-label="dot"] circle:not(${city})`)].map(c => [c, +c.getAttribute("r")]);
    const vecs = [...svg.querySelectorAll('g[aria-label="vector"] path')].map(p => {
      const m = /^translate\(([^,]+),([^)]+)\)(.*)$/.exec(p.getAttribute("transform") ?? "");
      return m && [p, +m[1], +m[2], m[3]];
    }).filter(Boolean);
    // city points and labels (cityMarks): circles by cx/cy, stars and text by their translate; size fixed
    const cities = [...svg.querySelectorAll(city)].map(e => {
      if (e.tagName === "circle") return [e, +e.getAttribute("cx"), +e.getAttribute("cy"), null];
      const m = /^translate\(([^,]+),([^)]+)\)(.*)$/.exec(e.getAttribute("transform") ?? "");
      return m && [e, +m[1], +m[2], m[3]];
    }).filter(Boolean);
    const zoom = d3.zoom().scaleExtent([1, 60]).on("zoom", ({ transform: t }) => {
      layers.forEach(g => g.setAttribute("transform", t));
      dots.forEach(([c, r]) => c.setAttribute("r", r / Math.sqrt(t.k)));
      vecs.forEach(([p, x, y, rest]) => p.setAttribute("transform", `translate(${t.applyX(x)},${t.applyY(y)})${rest}`));
      cities.forEach(([e, x, y, rest]) => rest === null ? (e.setAttribute("cx", t.applyX(x)), e.setAttribute("cy", t.applyY(y)))
        : e.setAttribute("transform", `translate(${t.applyX(x)},${t.applyY(y)})${rest}`));
    });
    d3.select(svg).style("cursor", "grab").call(zoom);
    const reset = html`<button type="button" class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-secondary map-reset" title="Reset zoom">Reset</button>`;
    reset.onclick = () => d3.select(svg).transition().duration(300).call(zoom.transform, d3.zoomIdentity);
    (el.tagName === "svg" ? el.parentElement : el).append(reset);
  };
  const scan = () => document.querySelectorAll(".dash-map:not([data-zoom])").forEach(init);
  const obs = new MutationObserver(scan);
  obs.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });
  invalidation.then(() => obs.disconnect());
  scan();
  return init;
}
noMap = g => empty(g === null ? `No VoteHub precinct map for ${cur.state} (expected ${geo_url}/${cur.state.toLowerCase()}.json).` : "Loading map…")
```

```{ojs model-controls}
// value = { model, all }: model is the full name (e.g. pois_bayes/strat_d/conformal); the
// toolbar's global "As of" (asofT) sets how far the plots run and which run the table shows
viewof mctl = {
  const isTop = m => m === top_model || `${modelParts.get(m)?.base}/${modelParts.get(m)?.spec}/${modelParts.get(m)?.interval}` === top_model;
  const start = [mctlMemo.model, modelsOk.find(isTop), modelsOk.find(m => mpc.some(d => d.model === m && d.pred_min != null)), modelsOk[0]]
    .find(m => m != null && modelsOk.includes(m)) ?? null;
  const form = html`<form class="model-ctl">
    <label>Model <select name="model" class="form-select form-select-sm"></select></label>
    <label name="all-wrap"><input type="checkbox" name="all" class="form-check-input"> Statewide</label>
  </form>`;
  const { model, all } = form.elements;
  // one select, grouped by base model; the base's default spec/interval first, then label order
  const rank = (labels, v) => { const o = Object.keys(labels); return o.includes(v) ? o.indexOf(v) : o.length; };
  const bases = [...new Set(modelList.map(m => modelParts.get(m).base))].sort();
  model.replaceChildren(...bases.map(b => {
    const g = document.createElement("optgroup");
    g.label = b;
    const ms = modelList.filter(m => modelParts.get(m).base === b).sort((x, y) => {
      const [p, q] = [modelParts.get(x), modelParts.get(y)];
      return (q.specDefault && q.intervalDefault) - (p.specDefault && p.intervalDefault) ||
        rank(SPEC_LABELS, p.spec) - rank(SPEC_LABELS, q.spec) || rank(INTERVAL_LABELS, p.interval) - rank(INTERVAL_LABELS, q.interval);
    });
    // set option properties directly: html`` writes disabled=${false} as a present attribute
    g.append(...ms.map(m => {
      const p = modelParts.get(m);
      const tag = !modelsOk.includes(m) ? " (failed)" : p.specDefault && p.intervalDefault ? " (default)" : "";
      return Object.assign(document.createElement("option"), { value: m, text: modelText(m) + tag, disabled: !modelsOk.includes(m), title: modelTitle(m) });
    }));
    return g;
  }));
  const allWrap = form.querySelector("[name=all-wrap]");
  const setModel = () => {
    allWrap.hidden = !mpc.some(d => d.model === model.value && d.geo === "all");
    all.checked = !allWrap.hidden && mctlMemo.all === true;
    model.title = model.selectedOptions[0]?.title ?? "";
  };
  const update = () => {
    form.value = { model: model.value || null, all: all.checked };
    if (!noModels) Object.assign(mctlMemo, { model: model.value });
  };
  model.addEventListener("input", setModel);
  all.addEventListener("input", () => { mctlMemo.all = all.checked; });
  form.addEventListener("input", update);
  form.addEventListener("submit", e => e.preventDefault());
  form.hidden = noModels;
  if (start) model.value = start;
  setModel();
  update();
  return form;
}
```

```{ojs model-table}
{
  if (noModels) return html`<div class="model-note">${msc.length ? "No model has produced predictions for this contest yet." : "This contest is not modeled."}</div>`;
  const latestRun = d3.max(summaryRows, d => d.time);
  const pick = m => {
    const s = viewof mctl.elements.model;
    s.value = m;
    s.dispatchEvent(new Event("input", { bubbles: true }));
  };
  const turnFmt = d3.format(".3s");
  // "4.14–4.26M": the low end drops the SI suffix it shares with the high end
  const turnRange = (lo, hi) => { const [a, b] = [turnFmt(lo), turnFmt(hi)]; const u = b.replace(/[\d.]/g, "");
    return `${u && a.endsWith(u) ? a.slice(0, -u.length) : a}–${b}`; };
  // rows built with the DOM: a bare <tr> fragment doesn't survive html``'s parser
  const td = (text, cls = "") => Object.assign(document.createElement("td"), { textContent: text, className: cls });
  const rows = summaryRows.map(d => {
    const tr = document.createElement("tr");
    tr.className = d.model === model_pick ? "selected" : "";
    tr.title = modelTitle(d.model);
    tr.dataset.model = d.model;
    const first = td("");
    first.append(Object.assign(document.createElement("code"), { textContent: d.base }));
    if (d.time < latestRun) first.append(" ", Object.assign(document.createElement("span"), { className: "model-stale", textContent: fmtTime(d.time), title: "Last run at or before As of" }));
    const spec = Object.assign(td(""), { title: SPEC_LABELS[d.spec]?.[1] ?? d.spec });
    spec.append(Object.assign(document.createElement("code"), { textContent: d.spec }));
    tr.append(first, spec, td(`${INTERVAL_SHORT[d.interval] ?? d.interval} ${confLevel(d.conf)}`.trim()),
      td(d.d2 == null ? "—" : d.lo == null || d.hi == null ? pct(d.d2) : `${pct(d.d2)} (${pct(d.lo)}–${pct(d.hi)})`, "num"),
      td(!(d.turnout > 0) ? "—" : d.tlo == null || d.thi == null ? turnFmt(d.turnout) : `${turnFmt(d.turnout)} (${turnRange(d.tlo, d.thi)})`, "num"),
      td(cur.match_of > 0 ? pct(cur.match_n / cur.match_of) : "—", "num"));
    return tr;
  });
  const tbody = document.createElement("tbody");
  tbody.append(...rows);
  tbody.addEventListener("click", e => { const m = e.target.closest("tr")?.dataset.model; if (m) pick(m); });
  return html`<div class="model-table-wrap">
    <table class="table table-sm model-table">
      <thead><tr>
        <th>Model</th><th title="Demographic spec (hover a row for its description)">Spec</th><th>Interval</th>
        <th class="num" title="Predicted Dem share of the two-party vote (interval)">Est. D (interval)</th>
        <th class="num" title="Predicted total votes, all candidates (interval, when the model gives one)">Turnout (interval)</th>
        <th class="num" title="Reporting precincts found in the models' historical inputs (input_data/model_inputs/{ST}_precinct.parquet); the same for every model">Match</th>
      </tr></thead>
      ${tbody}
    </table>
    <div class="model-note">
      As of ${fmtTime(asof)} ET · ${summaryRows.length ? pct(d3.max(summaryRows, d => d.pct_rep)) : "—"} of precincts reporting · click a row to plot it
      ${cur.match_of > 0 ? html`<div>Match: ${fmt(cur.match_n)} of ${fmt(cur.match_of)} reporting precincts are in the models' historical inputs (${pct(cur.hist_match)} of counted votes); the inputs have ${fmt(cur.n_frame)} precincts. Same for every model.</div>` : ""}
      <div>Plots: solid prediction · band interval · dotted reported${hasAll ? " · dashed statewide (all counties)" : ""}${cbsExp.length ? html`&nbsp;· <span style="color:${CBS_COLOR}">orange</span> CBS expected vote (Predicted Turnout)` : ""}</div>
    </div>
  </div>`;
}
```

```{ojs}
{
```

```{ojs}
    .map(d => { const f = g.byId.get(d.unit_id); return { ...d, feature: f, cx: f.properties.cx, cy: f.properties.cy, margin: (d.dem - d.rep) / (d.dem + d.rep) }; });
  // counties we don't scrape: CBS county results
  const cty = mctyc.filter(d => d.dem + d.rep > 0 && g.countyById.has(d.county_fips))
    .map(d => ({ ...d, feature: g.countyById.get(d.county_fips), margin: (d.dem - d.rep) / (d.dem + d.rep) }));
  const s = exportable("Results Map", {
    projection: g.projection,
    color: marginColor,
    caption: `Counted votes as of ${fmtTime(cur.time)} ET · ${fmt(res.length)} of ${fmt(g.features.length)} precincts reporting · grey: none yet or not matched` +
      (cty.length ? ` · ${fmt(cty.length)} unscraped counties: CBS county results as of ${fmtTime(cur.cbs_time)} ET` : ""),
    // the export's title, subtitle and legend already carry the time and the grey key
    exportCaption: `${fmt(res.length)} of ${fmt(g.features.length)} precincts reporting` +
      (cty.length ? ` · ${fmt(cty.length)} unscraped counties: CBS county results` : ""),
    marks: [
      Plot.geo(g.counties, { fill: MAP_BLANK }),
      Plot.geo(g.features, { fill: MAP_BLANK, stroke: "white", strokeWidth: 0.3 }),
      Plot.geo(cty.map(d => d.feature), { fill: cty.map(d => d.margin),
        title: cty.map(d => `${d.county_name} County (CBS)\n${partyName("dem")} ${fmt(Math.round(d.dem))} · ${partyName("rep")} ${fmt(Math.round(d.rep))}\n${marginColor.tickFormat(Math.round(d.margin * 100) / 100)} · ${fmt(Math.round(d.total))} votes · ${Math.round(d.pct_exp)}% of expected vote`) }),
      Plot.geo(res.map(d => d.feature), { fill: res.map(d => d.margin), stroke: "white", strokeWidth: 0.3,
        title: res.map(d => `${d.unit_id}\n${partyName("dem")} ${fmt(d.dem)} · ${partyName("rep")} ${fmt(d.rep)}\n${marginColor.tickFormat(Math.round(d.margin * 100) / 100)} · ${fmt(d.total)} votes`) }),
      ...outlineMarks(g),
      ...cityMarks(cur.state)
    ]
  }, "Precinct Results", { keys: [
    { mark: "rect", label: "No results yet or not matched", color: MAP_BLANK }
  ] });
  return Plot.plot({ className: "dash-map", projection: s.projection, color: s.color, caption: s.caption, marks: s.marks });
}
```
