```{ojs}
//| title: Shift Map
{
  const g = geoData;
  if (!g) return noMap(g);
  // counted votes only (no projections), against VoteHub's 2024 presidential estimate for the same unit
  const res = mresc.filter(d => d.dem + d.rep > 0 && d.dem24 + d.rep24 > 0 && g.byId.has(d.unit_id))
    .map(d => {
      const p = g.byId.get(d.unit_id).properties;
      const m26 = (d.dem - d.rep) / (d.dem + d.rep), m24 = (d.dem24 - d.rep24) / (d.dem24 + d.rep24);
      return { ...d, cx: p.cx, cy: p.cy, m26, m24, shift: m26 - m24 };
    })
    .sort((a, b) => Math.abs(a.shift) - Math.abs(b.shift));
  if (res.length === 0) return empty(mresc.length ? "No reporting precincts with a 2024 presidential result (VoteHub estimated_past_results.csv)." : "No precincts reporting yet.");
  // the same units' totals, 2026 counted vs 2024
  const marg = (d, r) => (d - r) / (d + r);
  const all26 = marg(d3.sum(res, d => d.dem), d3.sum(res, d => d.rep)), all24 = marg(d3.sum(res, d => d.dem24), d3.sum(res, d => d.rep24));
  const mfmt = x => marginColor.tickFormat(Math.round(x * 100) / 100);
  const sfmt = x => `${x >= 0 ? "D" : "R"}+${Math.abs(x * 100).toFixed(1)}`;
  const CAP = 0.3;
  // optional basemap: an L2 share per unit (shift_base); units with no L2 match stay grey
  const base = shift_base ? g.features.filter(f => mdemoc.get(f.id)?.[shift_base] != null) : [];
  const baseVal = base.map(f => mdemoc.get(f.id)[shift_base]);
  const s = exportable("Shift Map", {
    projection: g.projection,
    color: shift_base ? demoColor(shift_base) : undefined,
    length: { domain: [0, CAP], range: [0, 28], clamp: true },
    caption: `Counted votes as of ${fmtTime(cur.time)} ET vs. 2024 president · ${fmt(res.length)} reporting precincts` +
      ` · shift in two-party margin ${sfmt(all26 - all24)} (${mfmt(all24)} to ${mfmt(all26)})` +
      ` · arrows: ↖ toward ${partyName("dem")}, ↗ toward ${partyName("rep")}, length = shift, capped at ${CAP * 100} pts` +
      (shift_base ? ` · basemap: ${DEMO_VARS[shift_base].label} (${fmt(base.length)} of ${fmt(g.features.length)} precincts matched; grey: no match)` : ""),
    exportCaption: `${fmt(res.length)} reporting precincts` +
      (shift_base ? ` · basemap: ${DEMO_VARS[shift_base].label}, grey: no match` : ""),
    marks: [
      Plot.geo(g.counties, { fill: MAP_BLANK }),
      Plot.geo(g.features, { fill: MAP_BLANK, stroke: "white", strokeWidth: 0.3 }),
      ...(shift_base ? [Plot.geo(base, { fill: baseVal, stroke: "white", strokeWidth: 0.3,
        title: base.map((f, i) => `${f.id}\n${DEMO_VARS[shift_base].label}: ${pct(baseVal[i])} of ${fmt(mdemoc.get(f.id).l2_n)} registrants`) })] : []),
      ...outlineMarks(g),
      // tilted 35° up from horizontal; ARROW keeps the head one size whatever the length
      // stroke scale: null keeps the party colors literal when the basemap brings in a color scale
      Plot.vector(res, { x: "cx", y: "cy", length: d => Math.abs(d.shift), rotate: d => d.shift > 0 ? -55 : 55, anchor: "start", shape: ARROW,
        stroke: { value: d => d.shift > 0 ? DEM : REP, scale: null }, strokeWidth: 1.5, strokeOpacity: 0.85,
        title: d => `${d.unit_id}\n2024 president ${mfmt(d.m24)} · 2026 counted ${mfmt(d.m26)}\nShift ${sfmt(d.shift)}\n` +
          `${fmt(d.total)} votes counted · 2024 two-party ${fmt(d.dem24 + d.rep24)}` }),
      ...cityMarks(cur.state)
    ]
  }, "Shift Since 2024", { keys: [
    { mark: "arrow", label: `Toward ${partyName("dem")}`, color: DEM, dir: -1 },
    { mark: "arrow", label: `Toward ${partyName("rep")}`, color: REP, dir: 1 }
  ] });
  return Plot.plot({ className: "dash-map", projection: s.projection, color: s.color, length: s.length, caption: s.caption, marks: s.marks });
}
```

```{ojs}
//| title: Remaining Vote Map
{
  const g = geoData;
  if (!g) return noMap(g);
  if (noModels) return noModelsMsg();
  if (mprecc.length === 0) return empty(`No precinct projections for ${model_pick} (model_results/precincts_latest.parquet).`);
  const rows = mprecc.filter(d => g.byId.has(d.unit_id))
    .map(d => { const p = g.byId.get(d.unit_id).properties; return { ...d, cx: p.cx, cy: p.cy, margin: 2 * d.d2 - 1 }; })
    .sort((a, b) => b.rem - a.rem);
  const tot = d3.sum(rows, d => d.rem);
  const d2 = tot > 0 ? d3.sum(rows, d => d.rem * d.d2) / tot : null;
  const s = exportable("Remaining Vote Map", {
    projection: g.projection,
    color: marginColor,
    r: { type: "sqrt", domain: [0, d3.max(rows, d => d.rem)], range: [0, 14] },
    caption: `${mprecRun ? `Model run ${fmtTime(mprecRun.time)} ET · ` : ""}${fmt(Math.round(tot))} votes expected outstanding` +
      `${d2 == null ? "" : ` (${pct(d2)} D two-party)`} · circle area: expected remaining votes, color: their projected margin`,
    marks: [
      Plot.geo(g.counties, { fill: MAP_BLANK }),
      Plot.geo(g.features, { fill: MAP_BLANK, stroke: "white", strokeWidth: 0.3 }),
      ...outlineMarks(g),
      Plot.dot(rows, { x: "cx", y: "cy", r: "rem", fill: "margin", fillOpacity: 0.85, stroke: "white", strokeWidth: 0.5,
        title: d => `${d.unit_id}\n${fmt(d.rem)} votes expected outstanding\n${pct(d.d2)} D two-party (${marginColor.tickFormat(Math.round(d.margin * 100) / 100)})` }),
      ...cityMarks(cur.state)
    ]
  }, "Expected Remaining Vote", { keys: [
    { mark: "dot", label: "Expected remaining votes (area)", r: 6, opacity: 0.6 }
  ] });
  return Plot.plot({ className: "dash-map", projection: s.projection, color: s.color, r: s.r, caption: s.caption, marks: s.marks });
}
```

```{ojs demo-setup}
//| output: false

// ---- swing plots: each counted precinct's shift in Dem two-party share vs VoteHub's 2024 president, in blocks ----
// (two-party on both sides, as on the Results page's Shift Since 2024)
RURALITY = new Map(transpose(rurality).map(d => [`${d.state}|${d.county_cbs}`, d.rurality]))
RURAL_LABELS = { return { urban: "Urban (RUCC 1–3)", suburban: "Suburban (RUCC 4)", rural: "Rural (RUCC 5–9)" } }
histYY = "'24"
swingRows = !cur.has_pres ? [] : reported
  .filter(d => d.method === "Total" && d.dem + d.rep > 0 && d.pres_dem + d.pres_rep > 0)
  .map(d => {
    const d2 = d.dem / (d.dem + d.rep), h2 = d.pres_dem / (d.pres_dem + d.pres_rep);
    // ENR geo carries the cbs county number: ga_001_1B
    const cty = /^[a-z]{2}_(\d{3})_/i.exec(d.geo)?.[1];
    return { ...d, d2, h2, shift: d2 - h2, rurality: RURALITY.get(`${cur.state}|${cty}`) ?? null };
  })
// vote-weighted least squares of shift on h2, drawn across the block's h2 range; null when it can't be fit
// (fewer than SWING_FIT_MIN precincts: a slope through a handful of points is noise)
SWING_FIT_MIN = 20
swingFit = rows => {
  const W = d3.sum(rows, d => d.total);
  if (rows.length < SWING_FIT_MIN || !(W > 0)) return null;
  const mx = d3.sum(rows, d => d.total * d.h2) / W, my = d3.sum(rows, d => d.total * d.shift) / W;
  const sxx = d3.sum(rows, d => d.total * (d.h2 - mx) ** 2);
  if (!(sxx > 0)) return null;
  const b = d3.sum(rows, d => d.total * (d.h2 - mx) * (d.shift - my)) / sxx;
  return d3.extent(rows, d => d.h2).map(x => ({ x, y: my + b * (x - mx) }));
}
// groups: [{ label, rows }]; each block gets its fit line and its precinct-average shift (line and corner)
swingSpec = (groups, caption) => {
  const rows = groups.flatMap(g => g.rows.map(d => ({ ...d, group: g.label })));
  const stats = groups.map(g => ({ group: g.label, n: g.rows.length, avg: d3.mean(g.rows, d => d.shift) ?? null }));
  const fits = groups.flatMap(g => (swingFit(g.rows) ?? []).map(p => ({ ...p, group: g.label })));
  // symmetric y, trimmed to the 99th percentile so a few tiny precincts don't flatten the rest
  const m = Math.min(0.5, Math.max(0.05, d3.quantile(rows.map(d => Math.abs(d.shift)).sort(d3.ascending), 0.99) ?? 0.05));
  return {
    marginLeft: 56,
    fx: { domain: groups.map(g => g.label), label: null, padding: 0.12 },
    x: { domain: [0, 1], label: `Dem two-party share ${histYY} →`, tickFormat: ".0%", ticks: [0.25, 0.5, 0.75], grid: true },
    y: { domain: [-m, m], label: `↑ Shift vs. ${histYY}`, tickFormat: "+.0%", grid: true },
    r: { type: "sqrt", domain: [0, d3.max(rows, d => d.total)], range: [0.5, 5] },
    caption,
    marks: [
      Plot.ruleY([0], { stroke: "#999", strokeWidth: 1 }),
      Plot.dot(rows, { fx: "group", x: "h2", y: "shift", r: "total", fill: INK, fillOpacity: 0.3, clip: true,
        channels: { geo: "geo", county: "county", votes: "total" }, tip: true }),
      Plot.ruleY(stats.filter(s => s.avg != null), { fx: "group", y: "avg", stroke: INK, strokeWidth: 1.5, strokeDasharray: "4,4" }),
      Plot.line(fits, { fx: "group", x: "x", y: "y", z: "group", stroke: DEM, strokeWidth: 2, clip: true }),
      Plot.text(stats, { fx: "group", frameAnchor: "top-left", dx: 4, dy: 4, lineAnchor: "top", fontSize: 10,
        text: s => s.n ? `Avg ${d3.format("+.1f")(s.avg * 100)} pts\n${fmt(s.n)} precincts` : "No precincts" })
    ]
  };
}
swingKeys = [
  { mark: "dot", label: "Precinct (area: votes counted)", opacity: 0.3, r: 4 },
  { mark: "line", label: "Linear fit (vote-weighted)", color: DEM },
  { mark: "line", label: "Precinct average shift", color: INK, width: 1.5, dash: "4,4" },
  { mark: "line", label: "No shift", color: "#999", width: 1 }
]
swingCaption = what => `Counted votes as of ${fmtTime(cur.time)} ET vs. 2024 president (VoteHub) · ${what}`

// ---- race EI: each L2 race group's turnout and Dem two-party share, counted votes vs 2024 L2 voters by party label, same precincts ----
EI_GROUPS = { return { white: "White", black: "Black", hispanic: "Hispanic", asian: "Asian" } }
eic = transpose(ei).filter(d => d.key === sel)
eiYears = { return { hist: "2024", now: "Now" } }
eiColor = { return { type: "categorical", domain: [eiYears.hist, eiYears.now], range: ["#999999", DEM], legend: true } }
// thresholds are EI_MIN_FRAC / EI_MIN_N in scripts/functions.R
noEI = () => empty(cur.l2_match > 0 ? `Fewer than 25 precincts with an L2 match have counted at least half their 2022 votes (L2), so no EI yet.` :
  `No L2 race shares for ${cur.state} precincts (input_data/crosswalks/${cur.state.toLowerCase()}.csv).`)
eiNote = d => `${fmt(d.n)} precincts with at least half their 2022 votes counted and an L2 match · shares of today's L2 registrants ` +
  "of known race, non-voters included; 2024 is L2's voters by party label, treated as vote choice · seine (McCartan & Kuriwaki), no covariates, 95% intervals"
// one EI dot plot's spec: 2024 vs now per race group for field f (estimate / turnout), flagged or
// out-of-range estimates drawn hollow at the edge. Returns the spec, not the plot: Plot.plot()
// has to be called in the card's own cell for the dashboard to size it to the card
eiSpec = (name, title, f, axisLabel) => {
  const rows = eic.map(d => ({ ...d, label: eiYears[d.year], v: d[f.est], lo: d[f.lo], hi: d[f.hi] }));
  const pp = v => d3.format(".0%")(v);
  const shifts = Object.keys(EI_GROUPS).map(g => {
    const [h, n] = ["hist", "now"].map(y => rows.find(d => d.group === g && d.year === y));
    return h && n ? { group: g, shift: n.v - h.v } : null;
  }).filter(Boolean);
  const bad = d => d.flag || d.v < 0 || d.v > 1;
  const nBad = rows.filter(bad).length;
  const reg = new Map(rows.map(d => [d.group, d.reg_share]));
  return exportable(name, {
    marginLeft: 170,   // room for "Hispanic (6% of reg.)" at the export font size
    marginRight: 64,
    x: { domain: [0, 1], clamp: true, label: axisLabel, tickFormat: ".0%", ticks: [0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1], grid: true },
    y: { domain: [eiYears.hist, eiYears.now], axis: null },
    fy: { domain: Object.keys(EI_GROUPS), label: null, tickFormat: g => `${EI_GROUPS[g]} (${pp(reg.get(g))} of reg.)`, padding: 0.25 },
    color: eiColor,
    caption: `Counted votes as of ${fmtTime(cur.time)} ET vs. 2024 voters by L2 party label · ${eiNote(rows[0])}` +
      (nBad ? ` · ${nBad} unreliable estimate${nBad > 1 ? "s" : ""} (impossible values for the group) drawn hollow, see EI Diagnostics` : ""),
    marks: [
      Plot.frame({ stroke: "#ddd" }),
      Plot.ruleX([0.5], { stroke: "#d9d9d9", strokeWidth: 0.75 }),
      Plot.ruleY(rows, { fy: "group", y: "label", x1: "lo", x2: "hi", stroke: "label", strokeWidth: 10, strokeOpacity: 0.35 }),
      ...[[false, d => d.label], [true, "white"]].map(([out, fill]) =>
        Plot.dot(rows.filter(d => bad(d) === out), { fy: "group", y: "label", x: "v",
          stroke: "label", strokeWidth: 1.5, fill, r: 4, channels: { year: "label", low: "lo", high: "hi" },
          tip: { format: { x: ".1%", low: ".1%", high: ".1%", fy: false, y: false, stroke: false } } })),
      Plot.text(shifts, { fy: "group", frameAnchor: "right", dx: 8, textAnchor: "start", fontSize: 11,
        text: d => `${d3.format("+.1f")(d.shift * 100)} pts` })
    ]
  }, title, { swatch: "dot" });
}
```

```{ojs}
//| title: EI Diagnostics
{
  if (noVotes) return noVotesMsg();
  if (eic.length === 0) return noEI();
  const p1 = d3.format(".1%"), get = (g, y) => eic.find(d => d.group === g && d.year === y);
  const td = (text, cls = "") => Object.assign(document.createElement("td"), { textContent: text, className: cls });
  const cell = (d, e, lo, hi) => d ? `${p1(d[e])} (${p1(d[lo])} to ${p1(d[hi])})${d.flag ? " †" : ""}` : "—";
  const share = d => cell(d, "estimate", "conf_low", "conf_high"), turn = d => cell(d, "turnout", "turnout_low", "turnout_high");
  const shift = (h, n, e) => h && n ? `${d3.format("+.1f")((n[e] - h[e]) * 100)} pts` : "—";
  const tbody = document.createElement("tbody");
  for (const g of Object.keys(EI_GROUPS)) {
    const [h, n] = [get(g, "hist"), get(g, "now")];
    if (!h && !n) continue;
    const tr = document.createElement("tr");
    tr.append(td(EI_GROUPS[g]), td(p1((h ?? n).reg_share), "num"),
      td(turn(h), "num"), td(turn(n), "num"), td(shift(h, n, "turnout"), "num"),
      td(share(h), "num"), td(share(n), "num"), td(shift(h, n, "estimate"), "num"),
      td(d3.format(",.1f")((h ?? n).nu2), "num"));
    tbody.append(tr);
  }
  const r2 = (y, k) => d3.format(".2f")(eic.find(d => d.year === y)?.[k]);
  return html`<div class="model-table-wrap">
    <table class="table table-sm model-table">
      <thead><tr>
        <th>Group</th><th class="num" title="Group's share of L2 registrants of known race in these precincts">Share of reg.</th>
        <th class="num">Turnout 2024</th><th class="num">Turnout now</th><th class="num">Shift</th>
        <th class="num">Dem 2-party 2024</th><th class="num">Dem 2-party now</th><th class="num">Shift</th>
        <th class="num" title="Second moment of the Riesz representer: larger means less information about the group">ν²</th>
      </tr></thead>
      ${tbody}
    </table>
    <div class="model-note">
      <div>Turnout and Dem two-party share by L2 race group, estimated with seine (McCartan & Kuriwaki): ridge regression and Riesz representer, debiased, no covariates. Dem, Rep, other and non-voting are all shares of today's L2 registrants of known race, so groups can turn out at different rates; turnout is 1 − the non-voting estimate and Dem two-party share is Dem ÷ (Dem + Rep), with delta-method 95% intervals. Only precincts that have counted at least half their 2022 votes (L2's 2022 voters on today's file), and only with at least 25 of them.</div>
      <div>2024 is all L2: today's registrants who voted in 2024, split by L2 party label (Dem, Rep, the rest as other) and treated as if it were vote choice. It isn't: party labels are registration, or L2's model of it in states without party registration, so 2024 "Dem share" is closer to a share of Dem-labelled voters and runs more polarized than the vote. L2 also misses 2024 voters who have since left the file, so 2024 turnout reads a little low.</div>
      <div>† Unreliable: the group's turnout is outside 0–100% or its Dem or Rep vote estimate is negative, so the race shares carry too little information about it (usually with a large ν²).</div>
      <div>R² Dem / non-voting: ${r2("hist", "r2")} / ${r2("hist", "r2_turn")} (2024) · ${r2("now", "r2")} / ${r2("now", "r2_turn")} (now) · ${fmt(eic[0].n)} precincts</div>
    </div>
  </div>`;
}
```

# Redistricting

```{ojs redist-setup}
//| output: false

// congressional districts under the 2024 map (old) and the 2026 map (new), per redrawn state, from
// the vote source picked in the toolbar (build_redist_data() in scripts/redistricting_targets.R)
RD = transpose(rd_dist)
RSRC = transpose(rd_src).map(d => ({ ...d, time: Number.isFinite(d.time) ? new Date(d.time) : null }))
RDESC = new Map(transpose(rd_desc).map(d => [d.cd, d.desc]))
RD_STATES = [...new Set(RSRC.map(d => d.state))]
// the export buttons look charts on this page up by state
rdScope = `rd-${rst}`

// lean categories by Republican two-party margin (R - D), as in redistricting_lib.R
RD_SAFE = 0.10
RD_TOSS = 0.03
RD_LEANS = ["Safe D", "Lean D", "Competitive", "Lean R", "Safe R"]
rdLean = m => m <= -RD_SAFE ? "Safe D" : m <= -RD_TOSS ? "Lean D" : m < RD_TOSS ? "Competitive" : m < RD_SAFE ? "Lean R" : "Safe R"
RD_LEAN_COLORS = { const r = marginRange(DEM, REP); return [r[7], r[5], "#d9d9d9", r[2], r[0]]; }
// model estimates cover only the precincts the models project; districts under half covered are left out
RD_COV_MIN = 0.5
// R - D margin as "R+8" / "D+3" / "Even"
rdMfmt = m => Math.round(m * 100) === 0 ? "Even" : `${m > 0 ? "R" : "D"}+${Math.round(Math.abs(m) * 100)}`

rsrc = RSRC.find(d => d.state === rst && d.src === rctl) ?? null
rdKindText = s => s == null ? "" : s.kind === "model" ? `${s.race} · ${modelLabel(s)}` : s.kind === "count" ? `${s.label} votes counted` : s.label
// "ratio_strata · Majority race + region · Conformal (approx.)"
modelLabel = s => [s.model_base, s.model_spec && s.model_spec !== "default" ? specLabel(s.model_spec) : null,
  s.model_interval && s.model_interval !== "default" ? intervalLabel(s.model_interval) : null].filter(Boolean).join(" · ") || s.model
// caption lead: what the votes are and when, then the source's note (build_redist_data())
// (the counted races' notes without their "Counted Senate vote" lead: the picker names the race)
rdHead = s => s == null ? "" : [
  s.kind === "count" ? s.note.replace(/^Counted [^·]* vote( · )?/, "") : s.note,
  s.kind === "count" ? `as of ${fmtTime(s.time)} ET` : s.kind === "model" ? `model run ${fmtTime(s.time)} ET` : "",
  rdPlaced(s)
].filter(Boolean).join(" · ")
// share of the source's votes placed in districts by precinct vs by county (p_prec, build_redist_data())
rdPlaced = s => s == null || !Number.isFinite(s.p_prec) ? "" :
  `Votes placed by precinct ${pct(s.p_prec)}, by county ${pct(1 - s.p_prec)}`
// the map's fills for the picked source: votes by precinct (dashboard VoteHub unit) and by county
rdUnit = new Map(transpose(rd_unit).filter(d => d.state === rst && d.src === rctl).map(d => [d.unit_id, d]))
rdCty = new Map(transpose(rd_cty).filter(d => d.state === rst && d.src === rctl).map(d => [d.county_fips, d]))

// one row per district number: { cd, num, old: { m, dem, rep, ok }, new: {...}, dir, change }
rdRows = {
  const rows = RD.filter(d => d.state === rst && d.src === rctl);
  const side = d => d && d.dem + d.rep > 0
    ? { m: (d.rep - d.dem) / (d.dem + d.rep), dem: d.dem, rep: d.rep, ok: !(Number.isFinite(d.cov) && d.cov < RD_COV_MIN) }
    : null;
  return d3.groups(rows, d => d.cd).map(([cd, v]) => {
    const o = side(v.find(d => d.plan === "old")), n = side(v.find(d => d.plan === "new"));
    const change = o && n ? n.m - o.m : null;
    return { cd, num: +cd.slice(3), desc: RDESC.get(cd) ?? null, old: o, new: n, change,
             ok: !!(o?.ok && n?.ok),
             dir: change == null ? "No match" : Math.abs(change) < 0.01 ? "Moved < 1 pt" : change > 0 ? "Toward Rep" : "Toward Dem" };
  }).sort((a, b) => d3.descending(a.new?.m ?? a.old?.m, b.new?.m ?? b.old?.m));
}
rdOk = rdRows.filter(d => d.ok)
rdLeftOut = rdRows.length - rdOk.length
rdLeftNote = rdLeftOut ? ` · ${rdLeftOut} ${rdLeftOut === 1 ? "district" : "districts"} left out (${rsrc?.kind === "model" ? "projections cover under half the vote" : "no votes counted in them yet"})` : ""
rdEmpty = () => empty(RSRC.length === 0
  ? "No redistricting data. Run scripts/model/reports/redistricting_compare.R (no --live) before the night."
  : `No district results for ${rst} from this source yet.`)
// export subtitle and file prefix
rdExportOpt = { return { scope: rdScope, sub: `${rst} · ${rdKindText(rsrc)}${rsrc?.time ? ` · as of ${fmtTime(rsrc.time)} ET` : ""}`,
  file: `${rst}-redistricting`, time: rsrc?.time ?? Date.now() } }

// the state picker takes the contest picker's place in the header while this page is showing
rst = {
  const params = new URLSearchParams(location.search);
  const states = RD_STATES.length ? RD_STATES : ["NC"];
  const start = states.includes(params.get("s")) ? params.get("s") : states[0];
  const s = html`<select class="form-select form-select-sm dash-select redist-select" aria-label="State">
    ${states.map(st => html`<option value=${st} selected=${st === start}>${st} congressional districts</option>`)}
  </select>`;
  s.value = start;
  s.addEventListener("input", () => {
    const p = new URLSearchParams(location.search);
    p.set("s", s.value);
    history.replaceState(null, "", `${location.pathname}?${p}${location.hash}`);
  });
  const title = document.querySelector("#quarto-dashboard-header .navbar-title");
  document.querySelector(".redist-select")?.remove();
  (document.querySelector(".dash-select:not(.redist-select)") ?? title)?.after(s);
  const sync = () => {
    const on = document.querySelector("#tab-redistricting")?.classList.contains("active") ?? false;
    s.hidden = !on;
    document.querySelectorAll(".dash-select:not(.redist-select)").forEach(e => { e.hidden = on; });
  };
  document.addEventListener("shown.bs.tab", sync);
  invalidation.then(() => document.removeEventListener("shown.bs.tab", sync));
  sync();
  return Generators.input(s);
}

// last pick, kept across state changes (this cell has no inputs)
rctlMemo = { return {} }

// district outlines, both maps (redist_geo() in scripts/redistricting_targets.R), fetched once per state;
// prepGeo() fixes ring order and fits the projection to the state outline. The precincts ({st}.json,
// as on the Models page; geoCache shares the fetch) go in `prec` (null when the state has none)
rdGeoCache = new Map()
rdGeo = {
  const st = rst.toLowerCase();
  const get = f => fetch(`${geo_url}/${f}.json`).then(r => r.ok ? r.json() : null).catch(e => (console.warn(e), null));
  if (!geoCache.has(st)) geoCache.set(st, Promise.all([get(st), get(`${st}_counties`)])
    .then(([fc, cty]) => fc && prepGeo(fc, cty))
    .catch(e => (console.warn(e), null)));
  if (!rdGeoCache.has(st)) rdGeoCache.set(st, Promise.all([get(`${st}_districts`), get(`${st}_counties`), geoCache.get(st)])
    .then(([fc, cty, pg]) => fc && { ...prepGeo(fc, cty), prec: pg?.features ?? null })
    .catch(e => (console.warn(e), null)));
  return rdGeoCache.get(st);
}

// the map's fills, the same under both maps: each county's votes placed by county (MAP_BLANK when
// none), then each precinct's own votes over it, both by two-party margin (D - R, marginColor)
rdFillMarks = (g, unit, cty) => {
  const dm = v => (v.dem - v.rep) / (v.dem + v.rep);
  const tip = (name, v) => `${name}\n${rdMfmt(-dm(v))} · Dem ${fmt(v.dem)} · Rep ${fmt(v.rep)}`;
  const cv = x => cty.get(x.id) ?? null, uv = x => unit.get(x.id) ?? null;
  const prec = (g.prec ?? []).filter(uv);
  const t = "rd-prec-fill";
  return [
    Plot.geo(g.counties.filter(x => !cv(x)), { fill: MAP_BLANK, stroke: MAP_BLANK, ariaDescription: t, title: x => `${x.properties.name ?? x.id} County\nNo votes` }),
    Plot.geo(g.counties.filter(cv), { fill: x => dm(cv(x)), stroke: x => dm(cv(x)), ariaDescription: t,
      title: x => tip(`${x.properties.name ?? x.id} County (${cv(x).reported ? "counted votes, no projection" : "votes placed by county"})`, cv(x)) }),
    Plot.geo(prec, { fill: x => dm(uv(x)), stroke: x => dm(uv(x)), strokeWidth: 0.3, ariaDescription: t, title: x => tip(`Precinct ${x.id}`, uv(x)) })
  ];
}
// the map's view (District or Precinct fills), kept across redraws; no inputs
rdViewMemo = { return { v: "district" } }
// one map's district fills (the District view: precincts and counties summed into districts) and
// lines and labels; aria-description tags them for the 2024 / 2026 fade and the view toggle
rdMapMarks = (g, plan, rows) => {
  const by = new Map(rows.map(d => [d.cd, d.ok ? d[plan] : null]));
  const f = g.features.filter(x => x.properties.plan === plan);
  const val = x => by.get(x.properties.cd) ?? null;
  const tag = part => `rd-${plan}-${part}`;
  const lab = f.map(x => { const v = val(x); return { lon: x.properties.lx, lat: x.properties.ly,
    text: v ? `${+x.properties.cd.slice(3)}\n${rdMfmt(v.m)}` : `${+x.properties.cd.slice(3)}` }; });
  const yr = plan === "old" ? 2024 : 2026;
  return {
    fill: [
      Plot.geo(f.filter(x => !val(x)), { fill: MAP_BLANK, stroke: MAP_BLANK, ariaDescription: tag("fill"),
        title: x => `${x.properties.cd} (${yr} map)\nNo estimate` }),
      Plot.geo(f.filter(x => val(x)), { fill: x => -val(x).m, stroke: x => -val(x).m, ariaDescription: tag("fill"),
        title: x => { const v = val(x); return `${x.properties.cd} (${yr} map)\n${rdMfmt(v.m)} · Dem ${fmt(v.dem)} · Rep ${fmt(v.rep)}`; } })
    ],
    top: [
      Plot.geo(f, { fill: "none", stroke: INK, strokeWidth: 1.2, ariaDescription: tag("top") }),
      Plot.text(lab, { x: "lon", y: "lat", text: "text", ariaLabel: () => "cd-label", ariaDescription: tag("top"), pointerEvents: "none",
        fill: "#212529", stroke: "white", strokeWidth: 3, strokeOpacity: 0.9, paintOrder: "stroke", fontWeight: 600, lineHeight: 1.05 })
    ]
  };
}
// the map's 2024 / 2026 fade, kept across redraws (resize, state or source change); no inputs
rdFadeMemo = { return { t: 1 } }

// county lines and the state outline, between the fills and the district lines
rdOutlines = g => [
  Plot.geo(g.counties, { fill: "none", stroke: "white", strokeWidth: 0.5, strokeOpacity: 0.7 }),
  ...(g.state ? [Plot.geo([g.state], { fill: "none", stroke: INK, strokeWidth: 1.2 })] : [])
]
```

## {.toolbar}

```{ojs redist-controls}
// value = the vote source id: "count:sen" / "count:gov" / "count:house" (each race's counted vote),
// "pres24" or "model:{race}:{model}"
viewof rctl = {
  const order = d => ({ "count:sen": 0, "count:gov": 1, "count:house": 2, pres24: 3 })[d.src] ?? 4;
  const opts = RSRC.filter(d => d.state === rst).sort((a, b) => order(a) - order(b));
  const form = html`<form class="model-ctl"><label>Votes <select name="model" class="form-select form-select-sm"></select></label></form>`;
  const { model } = form.elements;
  const opt = d => Object.assign(document.createElement("option"), { value: d.src,
    text: d.kind === "model" ? modelLabel(d) + (d.spec_default && d.interval_default ? " (default)" : "") : d.label,
    title: d.note });
  const group = (label, rows) => { const g = document.createElement("optgroup"); g.label = label; g.append(...rows.map(opt)); return g; };
  const races = [...new Set(opts.filter(d => d.kind === "model").map(d => d.race))].sort();
  model.replaceChildren(
    ...opts.filter(d => d.kind !== "model").map(opt),
    ...races.map(r => group(`${r} projection`, opts.filter(d => d.race === r).sort((a, b) => d3.ascending(a.model, b.model))))
  );
  const isTop = d => d.model === top_model || `${d.model_base}/${d.model_spec}/${d.model_interval}` === top_model;
  // the last pick (or the same kind / model in this state), else a counted race (Senate, governor, House), 2024
  const pick = [opts.find(d => d.src === rctlMemo.src), opts.find(d => rctlMemo.model && d.model === rctlMemo.model),
    opts.find(d => !rctlMemo.model && d.kind === rctlMemo.kind),
    opts.find(d => d.kind === "count"), opts.find(d => d.kind === "pres24"), opts.find(d => d.kind === "model" && isTop(d)), opts[0]].find(Boolean);
  if (pick) model.value = pick.src;
  const update = () => {
    form.value = model.value || null;
    const d = opts.find(x => x.src === model.value);
    model.title = d?.note ?? "";
    if (d) Object.assign(rctlMemo, { src: d.src, kind: d.kind, model: d.model ?? null });
  };
  model.addEventListener("input", update);
  form.addEventListener("submit", e => e.preventDefault());
  form.hidden = opts.length === 0;
  update();
  return form;
}
```

```{ojs}
{
  if (rdOk.length === 0) return rdEmpty();
  const s = exportable("Districts", {
    marginLeft: 48,
    marginBottom: 36,
    caption: `○ 2024 map · ● 2026 map · ${rdHead(rsrc)}${rdLeftNote}`,
    exportCaption: `${rdHead(rsrc)}${rdLeftNote}. A district number can cover different places on each map.`,
    x: { label: "Two-party margin →", tickFormat: rdMfmt, grid: true, ticks: 5 },
    y: { label: null, domain: rdOk.map(d => d.cd), tickSize: 0 },
    color: { type: "categorical", domain: ["Toward Dem", "Toward Rep", "Moved < 1 pt"], range: [DEM, REP, "#999999"], legend: true },
    marks: [
      Plot.ruleX([0], { stroke: "#999", strokeDasharray: "4,4" }),

      Plot.dot(rdOk, { y: "cd", x: d => d.old.m, r: 3.5, fill: "white", stroke: INK, strokeWidth: 1.2 }),
      Plot.dot(rdOk, { y: "cd", x: d => d.new.m, r: 3.5, fill: "dir" }),
      Plot.tip(rdOk, Plot.pointerY({ y: "cd", x: d => d.new.m, title: d => `${d.cd}${d.desc ? ` · ${d.desc}` : ""}\n` +
        `2024 map ${rdMfmt(d.old.m)} → 2026 map ${rdMfmt(d.new.m)}\n${rdLean(d.old.m)} → ${rdLean(d.new.m)}` }))
    ]
  }, "District Lean, 2024 vs. 2026 Map", { swatch: "dot", keys: [

    { mark: "dot", label: "2026 map", color: INK, r: 4 }
  ] }, { ...rdExportOpt, height: Math.round(240 + 28.8 * rdOk.length) });  // redistricting_compare.R's 10 x (2 + 0.24 n) inches
  return Plot.plot({ marginLeft: s.marginLeft, marginBottom: s.marginBottom, caption: s.caption, x: s.x, y: s.y, color: s.color, marks: s.marks });
}
```

```{ojs}
//| title: Seats
{
  if (rdOk.length === 0) return rdEmpty();
  const plans = [["old", "2024 map"], ["new", "2026 map"]];
  const cats = rdLeftOut ? [...RD_LEANS, "No estimate"] : RD_LEANS;
  const data = plans.flatMap(([p, label]) => cats.map(c => ({ plan: label, lean: c,
    n: c === "No estimate" ? rdLeftOut : rdOk.filter(d => rdLean(d[p].m) === c).length })));
  // each block's count at its middle (stacked in cats order, as the bars), dark on the light blocks
  const lab = plans.flatMap(([, label]) => {
    let y = 0;
    return cats.map(c => { const n = data.find(d => d.plan === label && d.lean === c).n; y += n; return { plan: label, lean: c, n, mid: y - n / 2 }; });
  }).filter(d => d.n > 0);
  const light = d => ["Competitive", "No estimate"].includes(d.lean);
  const text = (rows, fill) => Plot.text(rows, { x: "plan", y: "mid", text: "n", fill, fontSize: 13, fontWeight: 600 });
  const s = exportable("Seats", {
    marginBottom: 30,
    caption: `Safe: margin 10+ pts · Lean: 3 to 10 · Competitive: under 3 · ${rdHead(rsrc)}${rdLeftNote}`,
    exportCaption: `Safe: two-party margin of 10 points or more · Lean: 3 to 10 · Competitive: under 3. ${rdHead(rsrc)}${rdLeftNote}.`,
    x: { domain: plans.map(d => d[1]), label: null, padding: 0.3 },
    y: { label: "Seats", grid: true },
    color: { type: "categorical", domain: cats, range: [...RD_LEAN_COLORS, MAP_BLANK], legend: true },
    marks: [
      Plot.barY(data, { x: "plan", y: "n", fill: "lean", order: cats, stroke: "white", strokeWidth: 1,
        title: d => `${d.plan}: ${d.n} ${d.lean}` }),
      text(lab.filter(d => !light(d)), "white"),
      text(lab.filter(light), INK),
      Plot.ruleY([0])
    ]
  }, "Seats by Lean, 2024 vs. 2026 Map", {}, rdExportOpt);
  return Plot.plot({ marginBottom: s.marginBottom, caption: s.caption, x: s.x, y: s.y, color: s.color, marks: s.marks });
}
```

### District Map {width="66%"}

```{ojs}
//| title: District Map
{
  const g = rdGeo;
  if (!g) return g === null ? empty(`No district map for ${rst} (expected ${geo_url}/${rst.toLowerCase()}_districts.json).`) : empty("Loading map…");
  if (rdOk.length === 0) return rdEmpty();
  const old = rdMapMarks(g, "old", rdRows), neu = rdMapMarks(g, "new", rdRows);
  const fill = rdFillMarks(g, rdUnit, rdCty);
  // exports: one image per map in the view showing, same projection and text so the two are the same size
  const one = (p, view) => ({ projection: g.projection, color: marginColor, exportCaption: `${rdHead(rsrc)}${rdLeftNote}.`,
    marks: [...(view === "precinct" ? fill : p.fill), ...rdOutlines(g), ...p.top] });
  const register = view => exportable("District Map", {
    projection: g.projection,
    color: marginColor,
    marks: [...old.fill, ...neu.fill, ...fill, ...rdOutlines(g), ...old.top, ...neu.top]
  }, `${rst} Congressional Districts`, {}, { ...rdExportOpt, format: "svg",
    basemap: view === "precinct" ? "VoteHub precincts and U.S. Census Bureau district lines" : "U.S. Census Bureau district lines",
    multi: [{ s: one(old, view), title: `${rst} Congressional Districts, 2024 Map`, suffix: "2024-map" },
            { s: one(neu, view), title: `${rst} Congressional Districts, 2026 Map`, suffix: "2026-map" }] });
  const s = register(rdViewMemo.v);
  const plot = Plot.plot({ className: "dash-map", projection: s.projection, color: s.color, caption: s.caption, marks: s.marks });
  // the fade: each map's lines and labels at its own weight; in the District view the 2026 fills over
  // the 2024 ones at opacity t (the hidden map's fills stop taking the pointer); the Precinct view's
  // fills are the same under both maps
  const fade = html`<input type="range" min="0" max="1" step="0.01" class="form-range" aria-label="2024 map to 2026 map">`;
  fade.value = rdFadeMemo.t;
  const q = tag => plot.querySelectorAll(`[aria-description="${tag}"]`);
  const set = t => {
    rdFadeMemo.t = t;
    const dist = rdViewMemo.v === "district";
    q("rd-new-fill").forEach(e => { e.style.display = dist ? "" : "none"; e.style.opacity = t; e.style.pointerEvents = t < 0.5 ? "none" : ""; });
    q("rd-old-fill").forEach(e => { e.style.display = dist ? "" : "none"; e.style.pointerEvents = t >= 0.5 ? "none" : ""; });
    q("rd-prec-fill").forEach(e => { e.style.display = dist ? "none" : ""; });
    q("rd-old-top").forEach(e => { e.style.opacity = 1 - t; });
    q("rd-new-top").forEach(e => { e.style.opacity = t; });
  };
  const btn = (label, t) => Object.assign(html`<button type="button" class="btn btn-sm btn-link">${label}</button>`,
    { onclick: () => { fade.value = t; set(t); } });
  fade.addEventListener("input", () => set(+fade.value));
  // District / Precinct view toggle
  const views = [["district", "Districts"], ["precinct", "Precincts"]];
  const vbtns = views.map(([v, label]) => Object.assign(html`<button type="button" class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-secondary">${label}</button>`,
    { onclick: () => { rdViewMemo.v = v; sync(); register(v); set(+fade.value); } }));
  const sync = () => vbtns.forEach((b, i) => b.classList.toggle("active", views[i][0] === rdViewMemo.v));
  sync();
  set(rdFadeMemo.t);
  return html`<div class="redist-map">
    <div class="redist-fade"><div class="btn-group btn-group-sm me-3" role="group" aria-label="Map view">${vbtns}</div>${btn("2024 map", 0)}${fade}${btn("2026 map", 1)}</div>
    ${plot}
  </div>`;
}
```
